en.content: The exact order of boiling points of the compounds n-pentane, isopentane, butanone and 1-butanol is
en.explanation:
The exact order of the boiling points of the given compound is isopentane < n-pentane < butanone < 1-butanol.

The highest boiling will be of butanol because in butanol, molecules are associated due to extensive intermolecular hydrogen bonding.

Now butanone has higher boiling point from n-pentane and iso-pentane because butanone has stronger dipole-dipole interaction and n-pentane has higher boiling point than isopentane because of larger surface area, due to which n-pentane has greater van der Waals' force of attraction.

en.content: The exact order of acidity of the compounds p-nitrophenol, acetic acid, acetylene and ethanol is
en.explanation:
The correct order of acidity of the given compounds is acetylene < ethanol < p-nitrophenol < acetic acid.

Ethanol is stronger acid than acetylene. This is because after the loss of acidic proton (H+) the corresponding anion formed by ethanol is stabilised by the electronegative oxygen atom. Now p-nitrophenol is more acidic than ethanol because the phenoxide ion obtained after the deprotonation is stabilised by resonance effect and also by EWG effect (which is caused by $$-$$NO2 group).

Likewise, acetic acid is more acids than all of the given compounds as the formed carboxylate ion is stabilised by resonance which is due to the presence of electronegative oxygen atom.

en.content: For a spontaneous reaction at all temperatures which of the following is correct?
en.explanation:
The free energy change of a reaction is

$$\Delta$$G$$^\circ$$ = $$\Delta$$H$$^\circ$$ $$-$$ T$$\Delta$$S$$^\circ$$

Now, a spontaneous reaction is one that releases free energy and therefore, the sign of $$\Delta$$G must be negative.

So, when $$\Delta$$H is negative and $$\Delta$$S is positive, the sign of $$\Delta$$G will be negative and the reaction will be spontaneous at all temperature.

bn.explanation:

এখন, একটি স্বতঃস্ফূর্ত প্রতিক্রিয়া এমন একটি যা বিনামূল্যে শক্তি প্রকাশ করে এবং সেইজন্য, এর চিহ্ন $$\Delta$$G অবশ্যই ঋণাত্বক হতে হবে।

en.content: A given amount of Fe<sup>2+</sup> is oxidised by x mol of $$MnO_4^ - $$ in acidic medium. The number of moles of $$C{r_2}O_7^{2 - }$$ required to oxidise the same amount of Fe<sup>2+</sup> in acidic medium is
en.explanation:
In acidic medium,

$$\mathop {Mn}\limits^{ + 7} O_4^ - + 8{H^ + } + 5{e^ - } \to M{n^{2 + }} + 4{H_2}O$$ and $$F{e^{2 + }} \to F{e^{3 + }} + {e^ - }$$

So, number of moles of $$MnO_4^ - = {1 \over 5}$$ moles ..... (i)

Also, in acidic medium,

$$C{r_2}O_7^{2 - } + 14{H^ + } + 6{e^ - } \to 2C{r^{3 + }} + 7{H_2}O$$ and $$F{e^{2 + }} \to F{e^{3 + }} + {e^ - }$$

So, number of moles of $$\mathop {C{r_2}}\limits^{ + 6} O_7^{2 - } = {1 \over 6}$$ ...... (ii)

Now, from Eq. (i)

$${1 \over 5}$$ moles of $$MnO_4^ - $$ = x moles of $$MnO_4^ - $$

$$\therefore$$ $${1 \over 5}$$ = x

5x = 1 ..... (iii)

Put this value in Eq. (ii).

$${1 \over 6}$$ will be $${{5x} \over 6}$$

So, the number of moles of $$C{r_2}O_7^{2 - }$$ required to oxidise the same amount of Fe2+ in acidic medium is $${5 \over 6}x$$ or 0.83 x.

bn.content:
অ্যাসিড মাধ্যমে, নিদিষ্ট পরিমাণ Fe<sup>2+</sup> x মােল $$MnO_4^ - $$ দ্বারা জারিত হয়। অ্যাসিড মাধ্যমে ঐ পরিমাণ
Fe<sup>2+</sup> এর জারণের জন্য যে মােল সংখ্যক $$C{r_2}O_7^{2 - }$$ প্রয়ােজন সেটি হল
bn.explanation:
অম্লীয় মাধ্যমে,

$$\mathop {Mn}\limits^{ + 7} O_4^ - + 8{H^ + } + 5{e^ - } \to M{n^{2 + }} + 4{H_2}O$$ and $$F{e^{2 + }} \to F{e^{3 + }} + {e^ - }$$

সুতরাং, $$MnO_4^ - $$ এর মােল সংখ্যা $$ = {1 \over 5}$$ মােল ..... (i)

এছাড়াও, অম্লীয় মাধ্যমে,

$$C{r_2}O_7^{2 - } + 14{H^ + } + 6{e^ - } \to 2C{r^{3 + }} + 7{H_2}O$$ and $$F{e^{2 + }} \to F{e^{3 + }} + {e^ - }$$

সুতরাং, $$\mathop {C{r_2}}\limits^{ + 6} O_7^{2 - } $$ এর মােল সংখ্যা $$= {1 \over 6}$$ ...... (ii)

এখন, সমীকরণ (i) থেকে

$$MnO_4^ - $$ এর $${1 \over 5}$$ মোল = $$MnO_4^ - $$ এর x মোল

$$\therefore$$ $${1 \over 5}$$ = x

5x = 1 ..... (iii)

এই মানটিকে সমীকরণ (ii) এ রাখার পর

$${1 \over 6}$$ হবে $${{5x} \over 6}$$

সুতরাং, $$C{r_2}O_7^{2 - }$$ এর মোলের $${5 \over 6}x$$ or 0.83 x সংখ্যা, অম্লীয় মাধ্যমের একই পরিমাণ Fe2+ অক্সিডাইজ করতে লাগবে।

en.content: An element crystallises in a body centered cubic lattice. The edge length of the unit cell is 200 pm and the density of the element is 5.0 g cm<sup>$$-$$3</sup>. Calculate the number of atoms in 100 g of this element.
en.explanation:
Density of the element (d) = 5.0 g cm$$-$$3

Edge length of unit cell (a) = 200 pm = 200 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$10 cm

$$d = {{Z \times M} \over {{a^3} \times {N_A}}}$$

[where M = mass of element NA = Avogadro number Z = number of atoms per unit cell]

For body centred cubic lattice, Z = 2

$$5 = {{2 \times M} \over {{{(200 \times {{10}^{ - 10}})}^3} \times 6.022 \times {{10}^{23}}}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow M = {{5 \times {{(200 \times {{10}^{ - 10}})}^3} \times 6.022 \times {{10}^{23}}} \over 2}$$

$$ = {{5 \times {{(200)}^3} \times {{10}^{30}} \times 6.022 \times {{10}^{23}}} \over 2}$$

= 12.044 g

Now, 12.044 g of element have $$\to$$ $${6.022 \times {{10}^{23}}}$$ atoms

1 g will have $$\to$$ $${{6.022 \times {{10}^{23}}} \over {12.044}}$$ atoms

100 g will have $$\to$$ $${{6.022 \times {{10}^{23}}} \over {12.044}}$$ $$\times$$ 100 atoms

= 0.5 $$\times$$ 1025 atoms or

= 5 $$\times$$ 1024 atoms

en.content: Molecular velocities of two gases at the same temperature (T) are u<sub>1</sub> and u<sub>2</sub>. Their masses are m<sub>1</sub> and m<sub>2</sub> respectively. Which of the following expressions is correct at temperature T?
en.explanation:
Let two gases are A and B.

u1 = molecular velocity of gas A

u2 = molecular velocity of gas B

m1 = molecular mass of gas A

m2 = molecular mass of gas B

The root mean square velocity, $${u_{rms}} = \sqrt {{{3RT} \over M}} $$ (where, M = molecular mass, R = gas constant)

For gas A,

$${u_1} = \sqrt {{{3RT} \over {{m_1}}}} $$

$$u_1^2 = {{3RT} \over {{m_1}}}$$

$$T = {{u_1^2{m_1}} \over {3R}}$$ .... (i)

For gas B,

$${u_2} = \sqrt {{{3RT} \over {{m_2}}}} $$

$$u_2^2 = {{3RT} \over {{m_2}}}$$

$$T = {{u_2^2{m_2}} \over {3R}}$$ .... (ii)

From Eq. (i) and (ii),

$${{u_1^2{m_1}} \over {3R}} = {{u_2^2{m_2}} \over {3R}}$$

$$\therefore$$ $${{m_1}u_1^2}$$ = $${{m_2}u_2^2}$$

bn.content: একই তাপমাত্রায় (T), দুটি গ্যাসের অণুর গতিবেগ u<sub>1</sub> এবং u<sub>2</sub> এবং উহাদের অণুর ভর যথাক্রমে m<sub>1</sub> এবং m<sub>2</sub> হলে T তাপমাত্রায় নিম্নলিখিতগুলির মধ্যে কোনটি সঠিক?
bn.explanation:
ধরা যাক দুটি গ্যাস হল A এবং B।

u1 = A গ্যাসের আণবিক বেগ

u2 = B গ্যাসের আণবিক বেগ

m1 = গ্যাস A এর আণবিক ভর

m2 = গ্যাস B এর আণবিক ভর

মূল মানে বর্গ বেগ, $${u_{rms}} = \sqrt {{{3RT} \over M}} $$ (যেখানে, M = আণবিক ভর, R = গ্যাস ধ্রুবক)

গ্যাস A এর জন্য,

$${u_1} = \sqrt {{{3RT} \over {{m_1}}}} $$

$$u_1^2 = {{3RT} \over {{m_1}}}$$

$$T = {{u_1^2{m_1}} \over {3R}}$$ .... (i)

গ্যাস B এর জন্য,

$${u_2} = \sqrt {{{3RT} \over {{m_2}}}} $$

$$u_2^2 = {{3RT} \over {{m_2}}}$$

$$T = {{u_2^2{m_2}} \over {3R}}$$ .... (ii)

সমীকরণ (i) এবং (ii) থেকে,

$${{u_1^2{m_1}} \over {3R}} = {{u_2^2{m_2}} \over {3R}}$$

$$\therefore$$ $${{m_1}u_1^2}$$ = $${{m_2}u_2^2}$$

en.content: When 20 g of naphthoic acid (C<sub>11</sub>H<sub>8</sub>O<sub>2</sub>) is dissolved in 50 g of benzene, a freezing point depression of 2K is observed. The van't Hoff factor (i) is [K<sub>f</sub> = 1.72 K kg mol<sup>$$-$$1</sup>]
en.explanation:
$$\Delta$$Tf = i $$\times$$ kf $$\times$$ m

$$\Delta$$Tf = depression in freezing point of solvent

i = van't Hoff factor

kf = freezing point depression constant

m = molality

$$i = {{\Delta {T_f}} \over {m \times {k_f}}} = {2 \over {\left( {{{{w_{solute}} \times 100} \over {{M_{solute}} \times {W_{solvent}}}}} \right) \times 1.72}}$$

$$ = {2 \over {\left( {{{20 \times 1000} \over {172 \times 50}}} \right) \times 1.72}}$$

$$\left[ \matrix{ {M_{solute}} = {M_{({C_{11}}{H_8}{O_2})}} \hfill \cr = 12 \times 11 + 8 \times 1 + 2 \times 16 \hfill \cr = 172 \hfill \cr} \right]$$

$$ \Rightarrow i = {2 \over 4} = 0.5$$

en.content: Which of the following solutions will have highest conductivity?
en.explanation: Among the given solutions, NaCl, KNO<sub>3</sub> and HCl are strong electrolytes but conductivity also depends upon size of ions. en.content: 2.5 mL 0.4 M weak monoacidic base (K<sub>b</sub> = 1 $$\times$$ 10<sup>$$-$$12</sup> at 25$$^\circ$$C) is titrated with 2/15 M HCl in water at 25$$^\circ$$C. The concentration of H<sup>+</sup> at equivalence point is (K<sub>w</sub> = 1 $$\times$$ 10<sup>$$-$$14</sup>, at 25$$^\circ$$C)
en.explanation:
Let a weak monoacidic base is BOH. BOH is neutralised as follow

BOH + CHl $$\to$$ BCl + H2O

At point of equivalence, all BOH get converted into salt and the concentration of H+ ions is due to the hydrolysis of resultant salt, BCl.

$$\mathop {{B^ + }}\limits_{C(1 - h)} + {H_2}O$$ $$\rightleftharpoons$$ $$\mathop {BOH}\limits_{Ch} + \mathop {{H^ + }}\limits_{Ch} $$

Volume of HCl used

$${V_a} = {{{N_b}{V_b}} \over {{N_a}}} = {{2.5 \times 2 \times 15} \over {2 \times 5}} = 7.5$$ mL

Now, the concentration of salt, [BCl]

$$ = {{Conc.\,of\,base} \over {Total\,volume}} = {{2 \times 2.5} \over {5(7.5 + 2.5)}} = {1 \over {10}} = 0.1$$

So, $${K_h} = {{C{h^2}} \over {1 - h}} = {{{K_w}} \over {{K_b}}} = {{{{10}^{ - 14}}} \over {{{10}^{ - 12}}}} = {10^{ - 2}}$$

or $${{C{h^2}} \over {1 - h}} = {10^{ - 2}}$$

$${{0.1 \times {h^2}} \over {1 - h}} = {10^{ - 2}}$$

On calculating, h = 0.27 which is significant, not negligible.

$$\therefore$$ [H+] = Ch = 0.1 $$\times$$ 0.27 = 2.7 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$2 M

bn.content: 25 °C উষ্ণতায়, জলীয় দ্রবণে 2.5 ml. 0.4 (M) একটি মৃদু এক-আকি ক্ষারক (K<sub>b</sub> = 1 $$\times$$ 10<sup>$$-$$12</sup> , 25$$^\circ$$C উষ্ণতায়) $$2\over15$$ (M)  HC$$l$$  দ্রবণ দ্বারা টাইট্রেশন করা হল। প্রশমণ বিন্দুতে H<sup>+</sup> এর গাঢ়ত্ব হল
bn.explanation:
একটি দুর্বল মনোঅ্যাসিডিক বেস হল BOH। BOH অনুসরণ হিসাবে নিরপেক্ষ হয়

BOH + CHl $$\to$$ BCl + H2O

সমতা বিন্দুতে, সমস্ত BOH লবণে রূপান্তরিত হয় এবং H+ আয়নের ঘনত্ব ফলস্বরূপ লবণ, BCl-এর হাইড্রোলাইসিসের কারণে হয়।

$$\mathop {{B^ + }}\limits_{C(1 - h)} + {H_2}O$$ $$\rightleftharpoons$$ $$\mathop {BOH}\limits_{Ch} + \mathop {{H^ + }}\limits_{Ch} $$

ব্যবহৃত HCl এর আয়তন

$${V_a} = {{{N_b}{V_b}} \over {{N_a}}} = {{2.5 \times 2 \times 15} \over {2 \times 5}} = 7.5$$ mL

এখন লবণের ঘনত্ব [BCl]

$$ = {\text{ক্ষারকের ঘনত্ব} \over \text{মোট আয়তন}} = {{2 \times 2.5} \over {5(7.5 + 2.5)}} = {1 \over {10}} = 0.1$$

সুতরাং, $${K_h} = {{C{h^2}} \over {1 - h}} = {{{K_w}} \over {{K_b}}} = {{{{10}^{ - 14}}} \over {{{10}^{ - 12}}}} = {10^{ - 2}}$$

অথবা $${{C{h^2}} \over {1 - h}} = {10^{ - 2}}$$

$${{0.1 \times {h^2}} \over {1 - h}} = {10^{ - 2}}$$

গণনা করলে, h = 0.27 যা তাৎপর্যপূর্ণ, নগণ্য নয়।

$$\therefore$$ [H+] = Ch = 0.1 $$\times$$ 0.27 = 2.7 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$2 M

en.content: Solubility products (K<sub>sp</sub>) of the salts of types MX, MX<sub>2</sub> and M<sub>3</sub>X at temperature T are 4.0 $$\times$$ 10<sup>$$-$$8</sup>, 3.2 $$\times$$ 10<sup>$$-$$14</sup> and 2.7 $$\times$$ 10<sup>$$-$$15</sup> respectively. Solubilities (in mol dm<sup>$$-$$3</sup>) of the salts at temperature T are in the order.
en.explanation:
For salt MX, Ksp = [S] [S]

Ksp = 4 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$8 (given)

$$\therefore$$ 4 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$8 = [S]2

$$\therefore$$ S = 2 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$4

For salt MX2, Ksp = [S] [2S]2

Ksp = 3.2 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$14

$$[S] = {\left( {{{3.2 \times {{10}^{ - 14}}} \over 4}} \right)^{1/3}}$$

= (8 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$15)1/3 = 2 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$5

For salt MX3, Ksp = [3S]$$-$$3 [S]

Ksp = 2.7 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$15

$$[S] = {\left( {{{2.7 \times {{10}^{ - 15}}} \over {27}}} \right)^{1/4}}$$

= (10$$-$$16)1/4 = 10$$-$$4

$$\therefore$$ Solubility of MX order is

MX > MX3 > MX2

= (8 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$15)1/3 = 2 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$5

লবণ MX3, Ksp এর জন্য = [3S]$$-$$3 [S]

en.content: The reduction potential of hydrogen half-cell will be negative if
en.explanation:
Reduction hydrogen half-cell is H+|(xM)|Pt(H2); Pressure pH2

Half-cell reaction is

2H+ (aq) + 2e$$-$$ $$\to$$ H2(g)

n = 2

Reaction quotient $$ \Rightarrow Q = {{{p_{{H_2}}}} \over {{{[{H^ + }]}^2}}}$$

$${E_{red}} = E_{red}^o - {{0.0591} \over n}\log Q$$

$${E_{red}} = - {{0.0591} \over 2}\log Q$$

Case (a), $$\log Q = \log {1 \over 1} = 0$$ $$\therefore$$ Ered = 0

Case (b), $$\log Q = \log {1 \over 4} = - ve$$ $$\therefore$$ Ered = +ve

Case (c), $$\log Q = \log {2 \over 1} = + ve$$ $$\therefore$$ Ered = $$-$$ve

Case (d), $$\log Q = \log {2 \over 4} = - ve$$ $$\therefore$$ Ered = +ve

$$\therefore$$ Ered is negative for option (c).

bn.content: হাইড্রোজেন অর্ধ-কোষের বিজারণ বিভব ঋণাত্মক হবে যদি
bn.explanation:
ড্রোজেন অর্ধ-কোষের বিজারণ হল H+|(xM)|Pt(H2); চাপ pH2

অর্ধকোষ বিক্রিয়া হয়

2H+ (aq) + 2e$$-$$ $$\to$$ H2(g)

n = 2

বিক্রিয়ার ভাগফল $$ \Rightarrow Q = {{{p_{{H_2}}}} \over {{{[{H^ + }]}^2}}}$$

$${E_{red}} = E_{red}^o - {{0.0591} \over n}\log Q$$

$${E_{red}} = - {{0.0591} \over 2}\log Q$$

ঘটনা (a), $$\log Q = \log {1 \over 1} = 0$$ $$\therefore$$ Ered = 0

ঘটনা (b), $$\log Q = \log {1 \over 4} = - ve$$ $$\therefore$$ Ered = +ve

ঘটনা (c), $$\log Q = \log {2 \over 1} = + ve$$ $$\therefore$$ Ered = $$-$$ve

ঘটনা (d), $$\log Q = \log {2 \over 4} = - ve$$ $$\therefore$$ Ered = +ve

$$\therefore$$ বিকল্প (c) এর জন্য Ered ঋণাত্মক।

en.content: A saturated solution of BaSO<sub>4</sub> at 25$$^\circ$$C is 4 $$\times$$ 10<sup>$$-$$5</sup> M. The solubility of BaSO<sub>4</sub> in 0.1 M Na<sub>2</sub>SO<sub>4</sub> at this temperature will be
en.explanation:
Solubility of saturated solution = Solubility product

$$\therefore$$ Ksp = 4 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$5 (for BaSO4)

Let the solubility of BaSO4 in 0.1 M Na2SO4 be x.

$$BaS{O_4}$$ $$\rightleftharpoons$$ $$\mathop {B{a^{2 + }}}\limits_x $$ + $$\mathop {SO_4^{2 + }}\limits_x $$

$$N{a_2}S{O_4}$$ $$\rightleftharpoons$$ $$\mathop {2N{a^ + }}\limits_{2 \times 0.1\,(0.2)} $$ $$\mathop {SO_4^{2 - }}\limits_{(0.1)} $$

$$\therefore$$ Total ($$\mathop {SO_4^{2 - }}\limits_{} $$) = x + 0.1 $$\approx$$ 0.1 M

Thus, $${K_{sp}} = [B{a^{2 + }}]\mathop {[SO_4^{2 - }]}\limits_{} $$

4 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$5 = [x] (0.1)

$$\therefore$$ x = 4 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$4

$$\therefore$$ Solubility = 4 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$4 M

en.content: For the reaction $$_7^{14}N(\alpha ,p)\,{}^{17}O$$, 1.16 MeV (Mass equivalent = 0.00124 amu) of energy is absorbed. Mass on the reactant side is 18.00567 amu and proton mass = 1.00782 amu. The atomic mass of $${}^{17}O$$ will be
en.explanation:
Mass on the reactant side = 18.00567 amu

Mass of the proton = 1.00782 amu

Energy absorbed in the reaction = 1.16 MeV = 0.00124 amu

$${}^{14}N(\alpha ,p)\,{}^{17}O$$

This reaction can be simplified as

$$_7^{14}N + _2^4\alpha \buildrel {\Delta E} \over \longrightarrow _8^{17}O + _1^1H$$

where, $$\Delta$$E is the energy absorbed.

In this reaction, highly energetic alpha particle with kinetic energy 1.16 MeV are absorbed by $$_7^{14}N$$ nucleus to form $$_8^{17}O$$ isotope and a proton.

Hence,


According to conservation of mass-energy,

18.00567 amu = ($$_8^{17}O$$ + 1.0078 $$-$$ 0.00124) amu

$$_8^{17}O$$ = 18.00567 $$-$$ 1.0078 + 0.00124 = 16.99914 amu

bn.content:
$$_7^{14}N(\alpha ,p)\,{}^{17}O$$ কেন্দ্ৰকীয় বিক্রিয়ায় 1.16 Mev (ভরশক্তিতুল্যতা = 0.00124 amu) শক্তি শােষিত হয়।
বিক্রিয়াকারী পদার্থের দিকের ভর 18.00567 amu এবং প্রােটনের ভর = 1.00782 amu হলে <sup>17</sup>O এর
পারমাণবিক ভর হবে
bn.explanation:
বিক্রিয়ক দিকে ভর = 18.00567 amu

প্রোটনের ভর = 1.00782 amu

বিক্রিয়ায় শোষিত শক্তি = 1.16 MeV = 0.00124 amu

$${}^{14}N(\alpha ,p)\,{}^{17}O$$

এই প্রতিক্রিয়া হিসাবে সরল করা যেতে পারে

$$_7^{14}N + _2^4\alpha \buildrel {\Delta E} \over \longrightarrow _8^{17}O + _1^1H$$

যেখানে, $$\Delta$$E হল শোষিত শক্তি।

এই বিক্রিয়ায়, গতিশক্তি 1.16 MeV সহ অত্যন্ত শক্তিশালী আলফা কণা দ্বারা শোষিত হয় $$_7^{14}N$$ নিউক্লিয়াস এবং গঠন করে $$_8^{17}O$$ আইসোটোপ এবং একটি প্রোটন।

তাই,


ভর-শক্তি সংরক্ষণ অনুযায়ী,

18.00567 amu = ($$_8^{17}O$$ + 1.0078 $$-$$ 0.00124) amu

$$_8^{17}O$$ = 18.00567 $$-$$ 1.0078 + 0.00124 = 16.99914 amu

en.content: Let f : R $$\to$$ R be such that f(0) = 0 and $$\left| {f'(x)} \right| \le 5$$ for all x. Then f(1) is in
en.explanation:
Given,

$$f(0) = 0$$

and $$\left| {f'(x)} \right| \le 5$$

$$ \Rightarrow - 5 \le f'(x) \le 5$$

$$ \Rightarrow - 5 \le {d \over {dx}}(f(x)) \le 5$$

$$ \Rightarrow - 5dx \le d(f(x)) \le 5dx$$

Integrating both sides, we get

$$ \Rightarrow - 5\int {dx \le \int {d(f(x)) \le 5\int {dx} } } $$

$$ \Rightarrow - 5x + C \le f(x) \le 5x + C$$

Now, $$f(x) = - 5x + C$$

$$ \Rightarrow f(0) = - 5 \times 0 + C = C$$

$$ \Rightarrow C = 0$$ [as $$f(0) = 0$$ given]

$$\therefore$$ $$ - 5x \le f(x) \le 5x$$

$$ \Rightarrow - 5(1) \le f(1) \le 5(1)$$

$$ \Rightarrow - 5 \le f(1) \le 5$$

$$ \Rightarrow - 5 \le f(1) - 0 \le 5$$

$$ \Rightarrow - 5 \le f(1) \le 5$$

$$ \Rightarrow f(1) \in [ - 5,5]$$

en.content: If $$\int {{{\sin 2x} \over {{{(a + b\cos x)}^2}}}dx}  = \alpha \left[ {{{\log }_e}\left| {a + b\cos x} \right| + {a \over {a + b\cos x}}} \right] + c$$, then $$\alpha$$ is equal to
en.explanation:
Let $$I = \int {{{\sin 2x} \over {{{(a + b\cos x)}^2}}}dx} $$

$$ \Rightarrow I = \int {{{2\sin x\cos x} \over {{{(a + b\cos x)}^2}}}dx} $$

Put $$a + b\cos x = t$$

$$ \Rightarrow \cos x = {{t - a} \over b} \Rightarrow - b\sin xdx = dt$$

$$I = - {2 \over b}\int {\left( {{{t - a} \over b}} \right){1 \over {{t^2}}}dt} $$

$$ = - {2 \over {{b^2}}}\int {{{t - a} \over {{t^2}}}dt} $$

$$ = - {2 \over {{b^2}}}\left[ {\int {{1 \over t}dt - \int {{a \over {{t^2}}}dt} } } \right]$$

$$ = - {2 \over {{b^2}}}\int {\left[ {\log (t) - a{{{t^{ - 2 + 1}}} \over { - 2 + 1}}} \right] + C} $$

$$ = - {2 \over {{b^2}}}\left[ {\log \left| t \right| + {a \over t}} \right] + C$$

$$\therefore$$ $$I = - {2 \over {{b^2}}}\left[ {\log \left| {a + b\cos x} \right| + {a \over {a + b\cos x}}} \right] + C$$

$$ \Rightarrow \alpha = - {2 \over {{b^2}}}$$

ধরা যাক $$I = \int {{{\sin 2x} \over {{{(a + b\cos x)}^2}}}dx} $$

$$ \Rightarrow I = \int {{{2\sin x\cos x} \over {{{(a + b\cos x)}^2}}}dx} $$

বসিয়ে $$a + b\cos x = t$$

$$ \Rightarrow \cos x = {{t - a} \over b} \Rightarrow - b\sin xdx = dt$$

$$I = - {2 \over b}\int {\left( {{{t - a} \over b}} \right){1 \over {{t^2}}}dt} $$

$$ = - {2 \over {{b^2}}}\int {{{t - a} \over {{t^2}}}dt} $$

$$ = - {2 \over {{b^2}}}\left[ {\int {{1 \over t}dt - \int {{a \over {{t^2}}}dt} } } \right]$$

$$ = - {2 \over {{b^2}}}\int {\left[ {\log (t) - a{{{t^{ - 2 + 1}}} \over { - 2 + 1}}} \right] + C} $$

$$\therefore$$ $$I = - {2 \over {{b^2}}}\left[ {\log \left| {a + b\cos x} \right| + {a \over {a + b\cos x}}} \right] + C$$

en.content: Let $$g(x) = \int\limits_x^{2x} {{{f(t)} \over t}dt} $$ where x > 0 and f be continuous function and f(2x) = f(x), then
en.explanation:
Given,

$$g(x) = \int_x^{2x} {{{f(t)} \over t}dt} $$

and f is a continuous function and $$f(2x) = f(x)$$

As, f is a continuous function so we can apply Leibnitz Rule for differentiation.

$$\therefore$$ $$g'(x) = {d \over {dx}}(2x)\,.\,{{f(2x)} \over {2x}} - {d \over {dx}}(x)\,.\,{{f(x)} \over x}$$

$$ = 2\,.\,{{f(2x)} \over {2x}} - 1\,.\,{{f(x)} \over x}$$

$$ = {{f(x)} \over x} - {{f(x)} \over x}$$ [as f(2x) = f(x)]

$$ = 0$$

$$\therefore$$ $$g'(x) = 0 \Rightarrow g(x) = $$ constant function

$$ = \int\limits_{ - {1 \over 2}}^{{1 \over 2}} {{{\left[ {{{\left( {{{x + 1} \over {x - 1}} - {{x - 1} \over {x + 1}}} \right)}^2}} \right]}^{{1 \over 2}}}dx} $$

$$ = \int\limits_{ - {1 \over 2}}^{{1 \over 2}} {\left[ {{{4x} \over {{x^2} - 1}}} \right]dx} $$

$$ = \int\limits_{ - {1 \over 2}}^0 {\left[ {{{4x} \over {{x^2} - 1}}} \right]dx - \int\limits_0^{{1 \over 2}} {\left[ {{{4x} \over {{x^2} - 1}}} \right]dx} } $$

$$ = - 4\int\limits_{ - {1 \over 2}}^0 {{x \over {1 - {x^2}}}dx + 4\int\limits_0^{{1 \over 2}} {{x \over {1 - {x^2}}}dx} } $$

$$ = 2[\log (1 - {x^2})]_{ - {1 \over 2}}^0 - 2[\log (1 - {x^2})]_0^{{1 \over 2}}$$

$$ = - 2\log \left( {1 - {1 \over 4}} \right) - 2\log \left( {1 - {1 \over 4}} \right)$$

$$ = - 4\log {3 \over 4} = 4\log {4 \over 3}$$

en.content: If $$\int\limits_{{{\log }_e}2}^x {{{({e^x} - 1)}^{ - 1}}dx = {{\log }_e}{3 \over 2}} $$, then the value of x is
en.explanation:
Given,

$$\int\limits_{\log _e^2}^x {{{({e^x} - 1)}^{ - 1}}dx = \log _e^{{3 \over 2}}} $$

$$ \Rightarrow \int\limits_{\log _e^2}^x {{1 \over {{e^x} - 1}}dx = \log _e^{{3 \over 2}}} $$

$$ \Rightarrow \int\limits_{\log _e^2}^x {{{{e^{ - x}}} \over {{e^x}.{e^{ - x}} - {e^{ - x}}}}dx = \log _e^{{3 \over 2}}} $$

$$ \Rightarrow \int\limits_{\log _e^2}^x {{{{e^{ - x}}} \over {1 - {e^{ - x}}}}dx = \log _e^{{3 \over 2}}} $$

$$ \Rightarrow \left[ {{{\log }_e}|1 - {e^{ - x}}|} \right]_{\log _e^2}^x = \log _e^{{3 \over 2}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {\log _e}|1 - {e^{ - x}}| - {\log _e}|1 - {e^{ - \log _e^2}}| = \log _e^{{3 \over 2}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {\log _e}|1 - {e^{ - x}}| - {\log _e}\left| {1 - {1 \over 2}} \right| = \log _e^{{3 \over 2}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {\log _e}|1 - {e^{ - x}}| + \log _e^2 = \log _e^{{3 \over 2}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow \log _e^2(1 - {e^{ - x}}) = \log _e^{{2 \over 3}}$$

$$\therefore$$ $$2(1 - {e^{ - x}}) = {3 \over 2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow 1 - {e^{ - x}} = {3 \over 4}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {e^{ - x}} = {1 \over 4}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {e^x} = 4$$

$$ \Rightarrow x = \log _e^4$$

en.content: The normal to a curve at P(x, y) meets the X-axis at G. If the distance of G from the origin is twice the abscissa of P then the curve is
en.explanation:
We know, slope of tangent = $${{dy} \over {dx}}$$

and slope of normal = $$ - {{dx} \over {dy}}$$

$$\therefore$$ Equation of normal,

$$Y - y = - {{dx} \over {dy}}(X - x)$$

At point G, y = 0

$$\therefore$$ $$0 - y = - {{dx} \over {dy}}(X - x)$$

$$ \Rightarrow y{{dy} \over {dx}} + x = X$$

$$\therefore$$ $$G = \left( {y{{dy} \over {dx}} + x,0} \right)$$

$$\therefore$$ Distance of G from origin

$$OG = y{{dy} \over {dx}} + x$$

Given, OG = 2 $$\times$$ abscissa of p

= 2 $$\times$$ x-coordinate of p

= 2 x

$$\therefore$$ $$y{{dy} \over {dx}} + x = 2x$$

$$ \Rightarrow \int {y\,dy = \int {x\,dx} } $$

$$ \Rightarrow {{{y^2}} \over 2} = {{{x^2}} \over 2} + c$$

$$ \Rightarrow {y^2} - {x^2} = 2c$$

Which is rectangular hyperbola.

bn.content:
বক্ররেখার P (x, y) বিন্দুতে অভিলম্বটি x-অক্ষকে G বিন্দুতে ছেদ করে। যদি মূলবিন্দু থেকে G এর দূরত্ব
P-এর ভুজের দ্বিগুণ হয়, তবে বক্ররেখাটি
bn.explanation:
লম্বের সমীকরণ

$$Y - y = {{ - 1} \over {dy/dx}}(X - x)$$

যখন y = 0

তাহলে, $$G = \left( {x + y{{dy} \over {dx}},0} \right)$$

প্রশ্ন অনুযায়ী,

$$x + y{{dy} \over {dx}} = 2x \Rightarrow y{{dy} \over {dx}} = x$$

$$ \Rightarrow \int {y\,dy = \int {x\,dx} } $$

$$ \Rightarrow {{{y^2}} \over 2} = {{{x^2}} \over 2} + C \Rightarrow {{{y^2} - {x^2}} \over 2} = C$$

$$\Rightarrow$$ যা অধিবৃত্ত।

en.content: The differential equation of all the ellipses centred at the origin and have axes as the co-ordinate axes is where $$y^{\prime}\equiv{{{dx}\over {dy}}},y^{\prime\prime}\equiv{{{d^2}y\over {dx^2}}}$$
en.explanation:
We know that the equation of an ellipse whose center is at origin is

$${{{{(x - 0)}^2}} \over {{a^2}}} + {{{{(y - 0)}^2}} \over {{b^2}}} = 1$$

Differentiating both side w.r.t. x, we get

$${{2x} \over {{a^2}}} + {{2y.{{dy} \over {dx}}} \over {{b^2}}} = 0$$

$$ \Rightarrow {{y{{dy} \over {dx}}} \over {{b^2}}} = - {x \over {{a^2}}}$$

Now separating variable and constant term we get,

$${{y.{{dy} \over {dx}}} \over x} = - {{{b^2}} \over {{a^2}}}$$

Differentiating both side w.r.t. x, we get

$${{x.{d \over {dx}}\left( {y.{{dy} \over {dx}}} \right) - \left( {y.{{dy} \over {dx}}} \right).{d \over {dx}}(x)} \over {{x^2}}} = 0$$

$$ \Rightarrow {{x.\left( {y.{{{d^2}y} \over {d{x^2}}} + {{dy} \over {dx}}.{{dy} \over {dx}}} \right) - y.{{dy} \over {dx}}.1} \over {{x^2}}} = 0$$

$$ \Rightarrow xy{{{d^2}y} \over {d{x^2}}} + x{\left( {{{dy} \over {dx}}} \right)^2} - y{{dy} \over {dx}} = 0$$

$$ \Rightarrow xy.y'' + x.{(y')^2} - yy' = 0$$

[$${{{d^2}y} \over {d{x^2}}} = y''$$ and $${{{dy} \over {dx}} = y'}$$]

bn.content: মূলবিন্দুকেন্দ্র এবং অক্ষদ্বয় স্থানাঙ্ক অক্ষদ্বয় বরাবর এমন উপবৃত্ত পরিবারের অবকল সমীকরণ হবে। যেখানে $$y^{\prime}\equiv{{{dx}\over {dy}}},y^{\prime\prime}\equiv{{{d^2}y\over {dx^2}}}$$
bn.explanation:
আমরা জানি যে একটি উপবৃত্তের সমীকরণ যার কেন্দ্র উৎপত্তিস্থল $${{{x^2}} \over {{a^2}}} + {{{y^2}} \over {{b^2}}} = 1$$

উভয় পক্ষের পার্থক্য x এর সপেখ্যে, আমরা পাই

$${{2x} \over {{a^2}}} + {{2y} \over {{b^2}}}{{dy} \over {dx}} = 0$$

$$ \Rightarrow {{2y} \over {{b^2}}}{{dy} \over {dx}} = - {{2x} \over {{a^2}}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {y \over x}{{dy} \over {dx}} = - {{{b^2}} \over {{a^2}}}$$

আবার উভয় পক্ষের পার্থক্য x এর সপেখ্যে, আমরা পাই

$${y \over x}{d \over {dx}}\left( {{{dy} \over {dx}}} \right) + y'{d \over {dx}}\left( {{y \over x}} \right) = 0$$

$$ \Rightarrow {y \over x}y'' + y'\left( {{{xy' - y \times 1} \over {{x^2}}}} \right) = 0$$

$$ \Rightarrow {y \over x}y'' + y'\left( {{{xy' - y} \over {{x^2}}}} \right) = 0$$

$$ \Rightarrow xyy'' + x{(y')^2} - yy' = 0$$

যা প্রয়োজনীয় অবকল সমীকরণ।

en.content: If $$x{{dy} \over {dx}} + y = {{xf(xy)} \over {f'(xy)'}}$$, then | f(xy) | is equal to (where k is an arbitrary positive constant).
en.explanation:
Given,

$$x{{dy} \over {dx}} + y = {{xf(xy)} \over {f'(xy)}}$$ .... (1)

Let, $$xy = v$$

$$ \Rightarrow x{{dy} \over {dx}} + y\,.\,(1) = {{dv} \over {dx}}$$ ..... (2)

From (1) and (2), we get,

$${{dv} \over {dx}} = {{xf(xy)} \over {f'(xy)}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {{dv} \over {dx}} = {{xf(v)} \over {f'(v)}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {{f'(v)} \over {f'(v)}}dv = xdx$$

Now, integrating both side, we get

$$\int {{{f'(v)} \over {f(v)}}dv = \int {xdx} } $$

$$ \Rightarrow \log |f(v)| = {{{x^2}} \over 2} + \log K$$ [log K = constant]

$$ \Rightarrow \log |f(xy) - \log K = {{{x^2}} \over 2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow \log {{|f(xy)|} \over K} = {{{x^2}} \over 2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {{|f(xy)|} \over K} = {e^{{{{x^2}} \over 2}}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow |f(xy)| = K{e^{{{{x^2}} \over 2}}}$$

bn.content: যদি $$x{{dy} \over {dx}} + y = {{xf(xy)} \over {f'(xy)'}}$$ হয়, তবে | f(xy) | হবে (যেখানে k হল যদৃচছ ধনাত্বক ধ্রুবক।)
bn.explanation:
দেওয়া, $$x{{dy} \over {dx}} + y = {{xf(xy)} \over {f'(xy)'}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {d \over {dx}}(xy) = x{{f(xy)} \over {f'(xy)}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {{f'(xy)} \over {f(xy)}}d(xy) = x\,dx$$

$$ \Rightarrow \int {{{f'(xy)} \over {f(xy)}}d(xy) = \int {x\,dx} } $$

$$ \Rightarrow \log \left| {f(xy)} \right| = {{{x^2}} \over 2} + C$$

$$ \Rightarrow \left| {f(xy)} \right| = {e^{{{{x^2}} \over 2}}} + C = k{e^{{{{x^2}} \over 2}}}$$

en.content: The straight the through the origin which divides the area formed by the curves y = 2x $$-$$ x<sup>2</sup>, y = 0 and x = 1 into two equal halves is
en.explanation:

$$ = \left[ {2.{{{x^2}} \over 2} - {{{x^3}} \over 3}} \right]_0^1$$

$$ = \left[ {{x^2} - {{{x^3}} \over 3}} \right]_0^1$$

$$ = \left( {1 - {1 \over 3}} \right)$$

$$ = {2 \over 3}$$

This line and x = 1 line cut at point B.

y = m . 1 = m

$$ \Rightarrow 2 \times {1 \over 2} \times 1 \times m = {2 \over 3}$$

$$ \Rightarrow m = {2 \over 3}$$

$$\therefore$$ Equation of straight line,

$$y = {2 \over 3}x$$

en.content: The value of $$\int\limits_0^5 {\max \{ {x^2},6x - 8\} \,dx} $$ is
en.explanation:
$${x^2} = 6x - 8$$

$$ \Rightarrow {x^2} - 6x + 8 = 0$$

$$ \Rightarrow {x^2} - 4x - 2x + 8 = 0$$

$$ \Rightarrow x(x - 4) - 2(x - 4) = 0$$

$$ \Rightarrow (x - 4)(x - 2) = 0$$

$$ \Rightarrow x = 2,4$$

$$\therefore$$ Two graph cut's at 2 and 4.

From 0 to 2, y coordinate of y = x2 graph is more.

From 2 to 4, y coordinate of y = 6x $$-$$ 8 graph is more.

From 4 to 5, y coordinate of y = x2 graph is more.

$$\therefore$$ $$\int_0^5 {\max \{ {x^2},6x - 8\} dx} $$

$$ = \int_0^2 {{x^2}dx + \int_2^4 {(6x - 8)dx + \int_4^5 {{x^2}dx} } } $$

$$ = \left[ {{{{x^3}} \over 3}} \right]_0^2 + \left[ {{{6{x^2}} \over 2} - 8x} \right]_2^4 + \left[ {{{{x^3}} \over 3}} \right]_4^5$$

$$ = {8 \over 3} + \left[ {3{x^2} - 8x} \right]_2^4 + {{125} \over 3} - {{64} \over 3}$$

$$ = (48 - 32 - 12 + 16) + {{69} \over 3}$$

$$ = 20 + 23$$

$$ = 43$$

en.content: A bulb is placed at the centre of a circular track of radius 10 m. A vertical wall is erected touching the track at a point P. A man is running along the track with a speed of 10 m/sec. Starting from P the speed with which his shadow is running along the wall when he is at an angular distance of 60$$^\circ$$ from P is
en.explanation:
Given, radius of circular track is 10 m.


and speed of man = 10 m/sec. i.e. $$v = r{{d\theta } \over {dt}} = 10$$

Now, $$\tan \theta = {y \over r}$$

$$ \Rightarrow y = r\tan \theta $$

$$ \Rightarrow {{dy} \over {dt}} = r{\sec ^2}\theta \,.\,{{d\theta } \over {dt}}$$

$$ = {\sec ^2}\theta \,.\,r{{d\theta } \over {dt}}$$

$$ = {\sec ^2}60^\circ \,.\,(10)$$

$$ = {(2)^2} \times 10$$

$$ = 40$$ m/sec.

bn.content:
10 m ব্যাসার্ধ বিশিষ্ট বৃত্তীয় ট্রাকের কেন্দ্রে একটি বাল্ব রাখা হয়েছে। ট্রাকটিকে P বিন্দুতে স্পর্শ করে এমন
একটি উল্লম্ব দেওয়াল আছে। এক ব্যক্তি P বিন্দু থেকে 10 m/sec গতিবেগে ঐ ট্র্যাক বরাবর দৌড়ােচেছন।
P থেকে তাঁর অবস্থানের কৌণিক দূরত্ব যখন 60°, তখন ঐ ব্যক্তির ছায়া দেওয়াল বরাবর যাবে যে
গতিবেগে তা হল
bn.explanation:
প্রদত্ত, বৃত্তাকার ট্র্যাকের ব্যাসার্ধ 10 মিটার।


এবং মানুষের গতি = 10 m/sec. i.e. $$v = r{{d\theta } \over {dt}} = 10$$

এখন, $$\tan \theta = {y \over r}$$

$$ \Rightarrow y = r\tan \theta $$

$$ \Rightarrow {{dy} \over {dt}} = r{\sec ^2}\theta \,.\,{{d\theta } \over {dt}}$$

$$ = {\sec ^2}\theta \,.\,r{{d\theta } \over {dt}}$$

$$ = {\sec ^2}60^\circ \,.\,(10)$$

$$ = {(2)^2} \times 10$$

$$ = 40$$ m/sec.

en.content: Two particles A and B move from rest along a straight line with constant accelerations f and f' respectively. If A takes m sec. more than that of B and describes n units more than that of B in acquiring the same velocity, then
en.explanation:
For particle A,

Initial velocity = o

Final velocity = v

Acceleration = f

Time taken by A = t + m sec

distance travel by A = x + n

For particle B,

Initial velocity = o

Final velocity = v

Acceleration = f'

Time taken by B = t sec

Distance travel by B = x

For particle A,

v = f(t + m)

For particle B,

v = f' t

$$\therefore$$ f'(t) = f(t + m)

$$\Rightarrow$$ f'(t) $$-$$ ft = fm

$$ \Rightarrow {t^2} = {{{f^2}{m^2}} \over {{{(f' - f)}^2}}}$$

Also, for particle A,

$$n + x = {1 \over 2}f{(t + m)^2}$$

For particle B,

$$x = {1 \over 2}f'{t^2}$$

$$\therefore$$ $$x + {1 \over 2}f'{t^2} = {1 \over 2}f{(t + m)^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow n + {1 \over 2}f'{t^2} = {1 \over 2}f{t^2} + ftm + {1 \over 2}f{m^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow n + {1 \over 2}(f' - f){t^2} = fm \times {{fm} \over {f' - f}} + {1 \over 2}f{m^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow n + {1 \over 2}(f' - f) \times {{{f^2}{m^2}} \over {{{(f' - f)}^2}}} = {{{f^2}{m^2}} \over {(f' - f)}} + {1 \over 2}f{m^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow n + {{{f^2}{m^2}} \over {2(f' - f)}} = {{{f^2}{m^2}} \over {f' - f}} + {1 \over 2}f{m^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow n - {{{f^2}{m^2}} \over {2(f' - f)}} = {1 \over 2}f{m^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow n(f' - f) - {{{f^2}{m^2}} \over 2} = {1 \over 2}f(f' - f){m^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow n(f' - f) - {{{f^2}{m^2}} \over 2} = {1 \over 2}ff'{m^2} - {1 \over 2}{f^2}{m^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow n(f' - f) = {1 \over 2}ff'{m^2}$$

bn.content:
স্থিতাবস্থা থেকে দুটি বস্তু কণা A ও B যথাক্রমে সম ত্বরণ f ও f' সহ একটি সরলরেখা বরাবর যাত্রা করে।
A-র সময় লাগে B-র চেয়ে m sec. বেশি। A, B এর চেয়ে n একক অধিকপথ অতিক্রম করে ঐ
গতিবেগ অর্জনের জন্য। সেক্ষেত্রে
bn.explanation:
For particle A,

distance travel by A = x + n

For particle B,

Acceleration = f'

Time taken by B = t sec

Distance travel by B = x

For particle A,

v = f(t + m)

For particle B,

$$\therefore$$ f'(t) = f(t + m)

$$ \Rightarrow {t^2} = {{{f^2}{m^2}} \over {{{(f' - f)}^2}}}$$

Also, for particle A,

$$n + x = {1 \over 2}f{(t + m)^2}$$

For particle B,

$$x = {1 \over 2}f'{t^2}$$

$$\therefore$$ $$x + {1 \over 2}f'{t^2} = {1 \over 2}f{(t + m)^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow n + {1 \over 2}(f' - f){t^2} = fm \times {{fm} \over {f' - f}} + {1 \over 2}f{m^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow n + {1 \over 2}(f' - f) \times {{{f^2}{m^2}} \over {{{(f' - f)}^2}}} = {{{f^2}{m^2}} \over {(f' - f)}} + {1 \over 2}f{m^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow n + {{{f^2}{m^2}} \over {2(f' - f)}} = {{{f^2}{m^2}} \over {f' - f}} + {1 \over 2}f{m^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow n - {{{f^2}{m^2}} \over {2(f' - f)}} = {1 \over 2}f{m^2}$$

en.content: let $$\alpha$$, $$\beta$$, $$\gamma$$ be three non-zero vectors which are pairwise non-collinear. if $$\alpha$$ + 3$$\beta$$ is collinear with $$\gamma$$ and $$\beta$$ + 2$$\gamma$$ is collinear with $$\alpha$$ then $$\alpha$$ + 3$$\beta$$ + 6$$\gamma$$ is
en.explanation:
Given, $$\alpha$$ + 3$$\beta$$ is collinear with $$\gamma$$

$$\therefore$$ $$\alpha$$ + 3$$\beta$$ = $$\lambda$$$$\gamma$$ ...... (1)

and $$\beta$$ + 2$$\gamma$$ is collinear with $$\alpha$$

$$\therefore$$ $$\beta$$ + 2$$\gamma$$ = $$\mu$$$$\alpha$$ ...... (2)

Add 6$$\gamma$$ with equation (1), we get

$$\alpha$$ + 3$$\beta$$ + 6$$\gamma$$ = (6 + $$\lambda$$)$$\gamma$$ ...... (3)

Multiply equation (2) with (3) and add $$\alpha$$, we get

$$\alpha$$ + 3$$\beta$$ + 6$$\gamma$$ = (3$$\mu$$ + 1)$$\alpha$$ ..... (4)

From (3) and (4), we get

(6 + $$\lambda$$)$$\gamma$$ = (3$$\mu$$ + 1)$$\alpha$$ ..... (5)

As, $$\alpha$$, $$\beta$$, $$\gamma$$ are not pairwise collinear so in equation (5) coefficient of $$\gamma$$ and $$\alpha$$ must be zero.

$$\therefore$$ 6 + $$\lambda$$ = 0 and 3$$\mu$$ + 1 = 0

$$\therefore$$ From equation (3),

$$\lambda$$ + 3$$\beta$$ + 6$$\gamma$$ = (6 + $$\lambda$$)$$\gamma$$ = 0 $$\times$$ $$\gamma$$ = 0

bn.content:
মনে কর $$\alpha$$, $$\beta$$, $$\gamma$$ তিনটি অ-শূণ্য ভেক্টর যাদের মধ্যে কোন দুটি একযােগে সমরেখ নয়। যদি $$\alpha$$ + 3$$\beta$$ ও
$$\gamma$$  সমরেখ হয় এবং $$\beta$$ + 2$$\gamma$$ ও $$\alpha$$ সমরেখ হয়, তবে $$\alpha$$ + 3$$\beta$$ + 6$$\gamma$$ হবে
bn.explanation:
প্রদত্ত, $$\alpha$$ + 3$$\beta$$, $$\gamma$$-এর সাথে সমরেখ

$$\therefore$$ $$\alpha$$ + 3$$\beta$$ = $$\lambda$$1$$\gamma$$

$$\Rightarrow$$ $$\beta = {{{\lambda _1}} \over 3}\gamma - {\alpha \over 3}$$ .... (i)

এবং $$\beta$$ + 2$$\gamma$$ হল $$\alpha$$-এর সাথে সমরেখ

$$\therefore$$ $$\beta$$ + 2$$\gamma = \lambda$$2$$\alpha$$

$$\Rightarrow$$ $$\beta$$ = $$\lambda$$2$$\alpha$$ $$-$$ 2$$\gamma$$ ...... (ii)

সমীকরণ (i) এবং (ii) থেকে, আমরা পাই

$${{{\lambda _1}} \over 3}\gamma - {\alpha \over 3} = {\lambda _2}\alpha - 2\gamma $$

$$ \Rightarrow \alpha \left( {{\lambda _2} + {1 \over 3}} \right) = \gamma \left( {{{{\lambda _1}} \over 3} + 2} \right)$$

$$ \Rightarrow {\lambda _2} + {1 \over 3} = 0$$ এবং $${{{\lambda _1}} \over 3} + 2 = 0$$

$$ \Rightarrow {\lambda _2} = - {1 \over 3}$$ এবং $${{{\lambda _1}} \over 3} = - 2$$

$$ \Rightarrow {\lambda _1} = - 6$$ এবং $${\lambda _2} = - {1 \over 3}$$

সমীকরণ (i) এবং (ii) থেকে, $$\beta = - 2\gamma - {\alpha \over 3}$$

$$\therefore$$ $$\alpha + 3\beta + 6\gamma = \alpha + 3\left( { - 2\gamma - {\alpha \over 3}} \right) + 6\gamma $$

$$ = 0$$

en.content: What is the number of ways in which an examiner can assign 10 marks to 4 questions, giving not less than 2 marks to any question?
en.explanation:
According to the question,

Consider, x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 = 10, where xi $$\ge$$ 2

$$\Rightarrow$$ (x1 $$-$$ 2) + (x2 $$-$$ 2) + (x3 $$-$$ 2) + (x4 $$-$$ 2) = 2

$$\Rightarrow$$ y1 + y2 + y3 + y4 = 2, where yi $$\ge$$ 2, (where, x1 $$-$$ 2 = y1, x2 $$-$$ 2 = y2, x3 $$-$$ 2 = y3 and x4 $$-$$ 2 = y4)

$$\therefore$$ Number of ways = $${}^{2 + 4 - 1}{C_{4 - 1}} = {}^5{C_3} = 10$$

there does not exist bijective mapping between A and T, U.
there exists bijective mapping between A and T but not between A and U.
there exists bijective mapping between A and U but not between A and T.

en.explanation:
Since,

n(A) $$\ne$$ n(T)

and n(A) $$\ne$$ n(U)

$$\therefore$$ There does not exist bijective mapping between A and T, U.

bn.content:
মনে কর T ও U, R-এর উপর তিনমাত্রার যথাক্রমে লম্ব ম্যাট্রিক্সের সেট ও অবিশিষ্ট ম্যাট্রিক্সের
সেট এবং A = {1,0,1}, সেক্ষেত্রে

options.content: A ও T, U -এর মধ্যে একৈক উপরিচিত্ৰণ বিদ্যমান
A ও T, U-এর মধ্যে একৈক উপরিচিত্রণের অস্তিত্ব নেই
A ও T -এর মধ্যে একৈক উপরিচিত্রণ বিদ্যমান কিন্তু A ও U -এর মধ্যে নেই।
A ও U -এর মধ্যে একৈক উপরিচিত্ৰণ বিদ্যমান কিন্তু A ও T -এর মধ্যে নেই।

bn.explanation:
যেহেতু,

n(A) $$\ne$$ n(T)

এবং n(A) $$\ne$$ n(U)

$$\therefore$$ A এবং T, U এর মধ্যে দ্বিমুখী ম্যাপিং নেই।

en.content: Four persons A, B, C and D throw and unbiased die, turn by turn, in succession till one gets an even number and win the game. What is the probability that A wins the game if A begins?
en.explanation:
Even numbers on die are 2, 4, 6 and odd numbers on die are 1, 3, 5.

$$\therefore$$ P(even) = $${3 \over 6} = {1 \over 2}$$ and P(odd) = $${3 \over 6} = {1 \over 2}$$

According to the question,

$$P({A_{(wins)}}) = {1 \over 2} + {\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^4} \times {1 \over 2} + {\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^8} \times {1 \over 2} + {\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^{12}} \times {1 \over 2} + ...\infty $$

$$ = {1 \over 2} + {\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^5} + {\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^9} + {\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^3} + ...\infty $$

$$ = {{{1 \over 2}} \over {1 - {{\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)}^4}}} = {{{1 \over 2}} \over {{{15} \over {16}}}} = {1 \over 2} \times {{16} \over {16}} = {8 \over {15}}$$

bn.content:
A, B, C ও D চারজন ব্যাক্তি একটি নিরপেক্ষ ছক্কা পরপর ছুঁড়তে থাকলাে যতক্ষণ না একজন
জোড়সংখ্যা ছুঁড়লাে এবং জিতলাে। যদি A ছোড়া শুরু করে তবে তার জেতার সম্ভাবনা হবে ?
bn.explanation:
ডাই এর জোড় সংখ্যা হল 2, 4, 6 এবং ডাই এর উপর বিজোড় সংখ্যা হল 1, 3, 5।

$$\therefore$$ P(জোড়) = $${3 \over 6} = {1 \over 2}$$ এবং P(বিজোড়) = $${3 \over 6} = {1 \over 2}$$

প্রশ্ন অনুযায়ী,

$$P({A_{(\text{জেতার})}}) = {1 \over 2} + {\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^4} \times {1 \over 2} + {\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^8} \times {1 \over 2} + {\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^{12}} \times {1 \over 2} + ...\infty $$

$$ = {1 \over 2} + {\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^5} + {\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^9} + {\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^3} + ...\infty $$

$$ = {{{1 \over 2}} \over {1 - {{\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)}^4}}} = {{{1 \over 2}} \over {{{15} \over {16}}}} = {1 \over 2} \times {{16} \over {16}} = {8 \over {15}}$$

en.content: The mean and variance of a binomial distribution are 4 and 2 respectively. Then the probability of exactly two successes is
en.explanation:
We have,

Mean, np = 4

and variance, npq = 2

$$\therefore$$ $${{npq} \over {np}} = {2 \over 4} = {1 \over 2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow q = {1 \over 2}$$ $$\therefore$$ $$ \Rightarrow p = {1 \over 2}$$ and n = 8

$$\therefore$$ $$P(x = 2) = {}^8{C_2}{\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^2}{\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^6}$$

$$={}^8{C_2}{\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^8}$$

$$ = {{8 \times 7} \over {2 \times 1}} \times {1 \over {256}} = {7 \over {64}}$$

bn.content: একটি দ্বিপদ বন্টনের গড় 4 ও বৈষম্য 2 হলে ঠিক দুটি সফলতার সম্ভাবনা হবে
bn.explanation:
আমাদের আছে,

গড়, np = 4

এবং ভিন্নতা, npq = 2

$$\therefore$$ $${{npq} \over {np}} = {2 \over 4} = {1 \over 2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow q = {1 \over 2}$$ $$\therefore$$ $$ \Rightarrow p = {1 \over 2}$$ এবং n = 8

$$\therefore$$ $$P(x = 2) = {}^8{C_2}{\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^2}{\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^6}$$

$$={}^8{C_2}{\left( {{1 \over 2}} \right)^8}$$

$$ = {{8 \times 7} \over {2 \times 1}} \times {1 \over {256}} = {7 \over {64}}$$

en.content: If a > 0, b > 0 then the maximum area of the parallelogram whose three vertices are O(0, 0), A(a cos$$\theta$$, b sin$$\theta$$) and B(a cos$$\theta$$, $$-$$ b sin$$\theta$$) is
en.explanation:
We have vertices of parallelogram
O(0, 0), A(a cos$$\theta$$, b sin$$\theta$$) and B(a cos$$\theta$$, $$-$$ b sin$$\theta$$)


Here, OA = OB

$$\therefore$$ Area of parallelogram = 2 $$\times$$ area of $$\Delta$$OAB

$$ = 2 \times \left( {{1 \over 2} \times OP \times AB} \right)$$

$$ = 2 \times {1 \over 2} \times a\cos \theta \times 2b\sin \theta $$

$$ = 2 \times ab(\sin \theta \cos \theta )$$

$$ = ab\sin 2\theta $$

$$\therefore$$ Area will be maximum when $$\theta = {\pi \over 4}$$

$$\Rightarrow$$ Maximum Area = ab when $$\theta = {\pi \over 4}$$

bn.content: একটি সামান্তরিকের তিনটি কৌণিক বিন্দুর স্থানাঙ্ক হল O(0, 0), A(a cos$$\theta$$, b sin$$\theta$$) ও B(a cos$$\theta$$, $$-$$ b sin$$\theta$$),  যেখানে a > 0, b > 0। সামান্তরিকের সর্বোচচ ক্ষেত্রফল হবে
bn.explanation:
আমাদের কাছে সামান্তরিকের কৌণিক বিন্দু O(0, 0), A(a cos$$\theta$$, b sin$$\theta$$) ও B(a cos$$\theta$$, $$-$$ b sin$$\theta$$)


এখানে, OA = OB

$$\therefore$$ সামান্তরিকের ক্ষেত্রফল = 2 $$\times$$ $$\Delta$$OAB এর ক্ষেত্রফল

$$ = 2 \times \left( {{1 \over 2} \times OP \times AB} \right)$$

$$ = 2 \times {1 \over 2} \times a\cos \theta \times 2b\sin \theta $$

$$ = 2 \times ab(\sin \theta \cos \theta )$$

$$ = ab\sin 2\theta $$

$$\therefore$$ ক্ষেত্রফল সর্বাধিক হবে যখন $$\theta = {\pi \over 4}$$

$$\Rightarrow$$ সর্বাধিক ক্ষেত্রফল = ab when $$\theta = {\pi \over 4}$$

en.content: Let A be the fixed point (0, 4) and B be a moving point on X-axis. Let M be the midpoint of AB and let the perpendicular bisector of AB meets the Y-axis at R. The locus of the midpoint P of MR is
en.explanation:
Let point B = (2p, 0)


$$\therefore$$ Coordinates of M are (p, 2)

Now, Slope of AB = $${{4 - 0} \over {0 - 2p}} = - {2 \over p}$$

$$\therefore$$ Slope of MR = $${p \over 2}$$

$$\therefore$$ Equations of MR = $$y - 2 = {p \over 2}(x - p)$$

On putting x = 0, we get

$$y - 2 = - {{{p^2}} \over 2} \Rightarrow y = 2 - {{{p^2}} \over 2}$$

$$\therefore$$ Coordinates of R is $$\left( {0,2 - {{{p^2}} \over 2}} \right)$$

$$\therefore$$ Coordinates of P is $$\left( {{p \over 2},{{2 - {{{p^2}} \over 2} + 2} \over 2}} \right)$$

i.e. $$\left( {{p \over 2},2 - {{{p^2}} \over 4}} \right)$$

$$\therefore$$ $$y = 2 - {x^2} \Rightarrow y + {x^2} = 2$$

bn.content:
মনে কর A স্থির বিন্দু (0, 4) এবং B, x-অক্ষের উপর গতিশীল বিন্দু। M, AB-এর মধ্যবিন্দু এবং AB-
এর লম্ব-সমদ্বিখন্ডক y-অক্ষকে R বিন্দুতে ছেদ করে। MR-এর মধ্যবিন্দু P-এর সঞ্চারপথ হল
bn.explanation:
ধরুন বিন্দু B = (2p, 0)


$$\therefore$$ M এর স্থানাঙ্ক হল (p, 2)

এখন, AB এর নতি = $${{4 - 0} \over {0 - 2p}} = - {2 \over p}$$

$$\therefore$$ MR এর নতি = $${p \over 2}$$

$$\therefore$$ MR এর সমীকরণ = $$y - 2 = {p \over 2}(x - p)$$

x = 0 বসালে, আমরা পাব

$$y - 2 = - {{{p^2}} \over 2} \Rightarrow y = 2 - {{{p^2}} \over 2}$$

$$\therefore$$ R-এর স্থানাঙ্ক হল $$\left( {0,2 - {{{p^2}} \over 2}} \right)$$

$$\therefore$$ P-এর স্থানাঙ্ক হল $$\left( {{p \over 2},{{2 - {{{p^2}} \over 2} + 2} \over 2}} \right)$$

অর্থাৎ $$\left( {{p \over 2},2 - {{{p^2}} \over 4}} \right)$$

$$\therefore$$ $$y = 2 - {x^2} \Rightarrow y + {x^2} = 2$$

en.content: A moving line intersects the lines x + y = 0 and x $$-$$ y = 0 at the points A, B respectively such that the area of the triangle with vertices (0, 0), A and B has a constant area C. The locus of the mid-point AB is given by the equation
en.explanation:
Let coordinates of A are ($$\alpha$$, $$-$$ $$\alpha$$) and coordinates of B are ($$\beta$$, $$\beta$$)

$$\beta$$ + $$\alpha$$ = 2h and $$\beta$$ $$-$$ $$\alpha$$ = 2k

Now, Area of $$\Delta AOB = {1 \over 2} \times OA \times OB$$

$$ = {1 \over 2}\sqrt {2{\alpha ^2}} \sqrt {2{\beta ^2}} = \left| {\alpha \beta } \right| = c$$

$$ \Rightarrow {\alpha ^2}{\beta ^2} = {c^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow 16{\alpha ^2}{\beta ^2} = 16{c^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {\{ {(\beta + \alpha )^2} - {(\beta - \alpha )^2}\} ^2} = 16{c^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {(4{h^2} - 4{k^2})^2} = 16{c^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {h^2} - {k^2} = {c^2}$$

$$\therefore$$ Locus of the mid point P of MR is $${({x^2} - {y^2})^2} = {c^2}$$

bn.content:
একটি গতিশীল সরলরেখা x + y = 0 ওx - y= 0 সরলরেখাদ্বয়কে যথাক্রমে A ও B বিন্দুতে ছেদ করে
যেখানে (0, 0), A ও B এর দ্বারা গঠিত ত্রিভূজের ক্ষেত্রফল ধ্রুবক C হয়। AB-এর মধ্যবিন্দুর
সঞ্চারপথের সমীকরণ হল
bn.explanation:
ধরা যাক A-এর স্থানাঙ্ক হল ($$\alpha$$, $$-$$ $$\alpha$$) এবং B-এর স্থানাঙ্ক হল ($$\beta$$, $$\beta$$)

$$\beta$$ + $$\alpha$$ = 2h এবং $$\beta$$ $$-$$ $$\alpha$$ = 2k

এখন, $$\Delta$$AOB এর ক্ষেত্রফল = $${1 \over 2} \times OA \times OB$$

$$ = {1 \over 2}\sqrt {2{\alpha ^2}} \sqrt {2{\beta ^2}} = \left| {\alpha \beta } \right| = c$$

$$ \Rightarrow {\alpha ^2}{\beta ^2} = {c^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow 16{\alpha ^2}{\beta ^2} = 16{c^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {\{ {(\beta + \alpha )^2} - {(\beta - \alpha )^2}\} ^2} = 16{c^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {(4{h^2} - 4{k^2})^2} = 16{c^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {h^2} - {k^2} = {c^2}$$

$$\therefore$$ MR এর মধ্যবিন্দু P এর সঞ্চারপথ হল $${({x^2} - {y^2})^2} = {c^2}$$

en.content: The locus of the vertices of the family of parabolas $$6y = 2{a^3}{x^2} + 3{a^2}x - 12a$$ is
en.explanation:
Given equation of parabola

$$6y = 2{a^3}{x^2} + 3{a^2}x - 12a$$

$$ \Rightarrow 6y + 12a = 2a\left( {{a^2}{x^2} + {3 \over 2}ax} \right) = 2a\left( {{a^2}{x^2} + 2\,.\,{3 \over 4}ax + {9 \over {16}}} \right) - {9 \over 8}a$$

$$ \Rightarrow 6y + {{105} \over 8}a = 2a{\left( {ax + {3 \over 4}} \right)^2}$$

Let vertices are (h, k)

$$\therefore$$ $$h = {{ - 3} \over {4a}}$$ and $$k = {{ - 35a} \over {16}}$$

$$\therefore$$ $$hk = {{105} \over {64}}$$

$$\therefore$$ locus of the vertices is $$xy = {{105} \over {64}}$$

bn.content: অধিবৃত্ত পরিবার $$6y = 2{a^3}{x^2} + 3{a^2}x - 12a$$ -এর শীর্ষবিন্দু সমূহের সঞ্চারপথ হবে
bn.explanation:
অধিবৃত্তের সমীকরণ দেওয়া হয়েছে

$$6y = 2{a^3}{x^2} + 3{a^2}x - 12a$$

$$ \Rightarrow 6y + 12a = 2a\left( {{a^2}{x^2} + {3 \over 2}ax} \right) = 2a\left( {{a^2}{x^2} + 2\,.\,{3 \over 4}ax + {9 \over {16}}} \right) - {9 \over 8}a$$

$$ \Rightarrow 6y + {{105} \over 8}a = 2a{\left( {ax + {3 \over 4}} \right)^2}$$

ধরা যাক শীর্ষবিন্দুগুলি হল (h, k)

$$\therefore$$ $$h = {{ - 3} \over {4a}}$$ and $$k = {{ - 35a} \over {16}}$$

$$\therefore$$ $$hk = {{105} \over {64}}$$

$$\therefore$$ শীর্ষবিন্দুর সঞ্চারপথ হল $$xy = {{105} \over {64}}$$

en.content: A ray of light along $$x + \sqrt 3 y = \sqrt 3 $$ gets reflected upon reaching X-axis, the equation of the reflected ray is
en.explanation:
Given, equation of ray of light $$x + \sqrt 3 y = \sqrt 3 $$


On putting y = 0, we get $$x = \sqrt 3 $$

$$\therefore$$ Coordinates of A are $$\left( {\sqrt 3 ,0} \right)$$

Now, let B(0, 1) then B' = (0, $$-$$1)

$$\therefore$$ Equation of AB' is $${{y - 0} \over {0 + 1}} = {{x - \sqrt 3 } \over {\sqrt 3 - 0}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow \sqrt 3 y = x - \sqrt 3 $$

bn.content: $$x + \sqrt 3 y = \sqrt 3 $$ বরাবর একটি আলােকরশি x-অক্ষে প্রতিফলিত হয়। প্রতিফলিত রশ্মির সমীকরণ হবে
bn.explanation:
প্রদত্ত, আলোক রশ্মির সমীকরণ $$x + \sqrt 3 y = \sqrt 3 $$


y = 0 রাখলে আমরা পাব $$x = \sqrt 3 $$

$$\therefore$$ A এর স্থানাঙ্ক হল $$\left( {\sqrt 3 ,0} \right)$$

এখন, ধরুন B(0, 1) তারপর B' = (0, $$-$$1)

$$\therefore$$ AB' এর সমীকরণ হল $${{y - 0} \over {0 + 1}} = {{x - \sqrt 3 } \over {\sqrt 3 - 0}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow \sqrt 3 y = x - \sqrt 3 $$

en.content: Two tangents to the circle x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup> = 4 at the points A and B meet at M($$-$$4, 0). The area of the quadrilateral MAOB, where O is the origin is
en.explanation:
Given, equation of circle x2 + y2 = 4

Centre = (0, 0) and radius = 2

$$\therefore$$ $$MA = \sqrt {{{(4)}^2} - {{(2)}^2}} = \sqrt {12} = 2\sqrt 3 $$

$$\therefore$$ Area of quadrilateral MAOB

= 2 $$\times$$ area of $$\Delta$$MAO

$$ = 2 \times {1 \over 2}$$ $$\times$$ MA $$\times$$ OA

$$ = 2\sqrt 3 $$ $$\times$$ 2

$$ = 4\sqrt 3 $$ sq. units.

bn.content: x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup> = 4 বৃত্তের উপরিস্থ A ও B বিন্দুতে অঙ্কিত স্পর্শকদ্বয় M($$-$$4, 0) বিন্দুতে মিলিত হয়। চতুর্ভূজ MAOB (O মূলবিন্দু) -এর ক্ষেত্রফল হবে
bn.explanation:
দেওয়া হয়েছে, বৃত্তের সমীকরণ x2 + y2 = 4

কেন্দ্র = (0, 0) ও ব্যাসার্ধ = 2

$$\therefore$$ $$MA = \sqrt {{{(4)}^2} - {{(2)}^2}} = \sqrt {12} = 2\sqrt 3 $$

$$\therefore$$ চতুর্ভুজ MAOB এর ক্ষেত্রফল

= 2 $$\times$$ $$\Delta$$MAO এর ক্ষেত্রফল

$$ = 2 \times {1 \over 2}$$ $$\times$$ MA $$\times$$ OA

$$ = 2\sqrt 3 $$ $$\times$$ 2

$$ = 4\sqrt 3 $$ বর্গ একক

en.content: From a point (d, 0) three normal are drawn to the parabola y<sup>2</sup> = x, then
en.explanation:
Given, equation of parabola y2 = x

We know that for y2 = 4ax

if we draw a normal from (h, 0) on it then condition for three normal is h > 2a

$$\therefore$$ d > $${1 \over 2}$$

bn.content: (d, 0) বিন্দুথেকে y<sup>2</sup> = x অধিবৃত্তে তিনটি অভিলম্ব অঙ্কিত হল। সেক্ষেত্রে।
bn.explanation:
দেওয়া হয়েছে, অধিবৃত্তের সমীকরণ y2 = x

আমরা জানি যে y2 = 4ax এর জন্য

যদি আমরা এটির উপর (h, 0) থেকে একটি অভিলম্ব আঁকি তাহলে তিনটি অভিলম্বর জন্য শর্ত হল h > 2a

$$\therefore$$ d > $${1 \over 2}$$

en.content: If from a point P(a, b, c), perpendicular PA and PB are drawn to YZ and ZX-planes respectively, then the equation of the plane OAB is
en.explanation:
According to question the coordinates of A and B are (0, b, c) and (a, 0, c) respectively.

Now, perpendicular vector OA $$\times$$ OB

$$ = \left| {\matrix{ {\widehat i} & {\widehat j} & {\widehat k} \cr 0 & b & c \cr a & 0 & c \cr } } \right|$$

$$ = \widehat i(bc - 0) - \widehat j(0 - ac) + \widehat k(0 - ab)$$

$$ = bc\widehat i + ac\widehat j - ab\widehat k$$

$$\therefore$$ Required equation of plane is bcx + acy $$-$$ abz = 0

bn.content:
P(a, b, c) বিন্দু থেকে YZ-তল ও ZX-তলের উপর লম্ব যথাক্রমে PA ও PB টানা হল। সেক্ষেত্রে
OAB তলের সমীকরণ হবে
bn.explanation:
প্রশ্ন অনুসারে A এবং B এর স্থানাঙ্ক যথাক্রমে (0, b, c) এবং (a, 0, c)।

এখন, লম্ব ভেক্টর OA $$\times$$ OB

$$ = \left| {\matrix{ {\widehat i} & {\widehat j} & {\widehat k} \cr 0 & b & c \cr a & 0 & c \cr } } \right|$$

$$ = \widehat i(bc - 0) - \widehat j(0 - ac) + \widehat k(0 - ab)$$

en.content: A line with positive direction cosines passes through the point P(2, $$-$$1, 2) and makes equal angle with co-ordinate axes. The line meets the plane 2x + y + z = 9 at point Q. The length of the line segment PQ equals.
en.explanation:
Let direction cosines of line is (l, l, l).

$$\therefore$$ l2 + l2 + l2 = 1

$$\Rightarrow$$ 3 l2 = 1 $$\Rightarrow$$ l = $${1 \over {\sqrt 3 }}$$

$$\therefore$$ Direction cosines of line is $$\left( {{1 \over {\sqrt 3 }},{1 \over {\sqrt 3 }},{1 \over {\sqrt 3 }}} \right)$$

Now, equation of a line passing through P(2, $$-$$1, 2)

$${{x - 2} \over {1/\sqrt 3 }} = {{y + 1} \over {1/\sqrt 3 }} = {{z - 2} \over {1/\sqrt 3 }} = k$$ .... (i)

$$\Rightarrow$$ x = k + 2, y = k $$-$$ 1 and z = k + 2

Since line (i) meets the plane

2x + y + z = 9 at Q

$$\therefore$$ 2(k + 2) + (k $$-$$ 1) + (k + 2) = 9

$$\Rightarrow$$ 2k + 4 + k $$-$$ 1 + k + 2 = 9

$$\Rightarrow$$ 4k + 5 = 9

$$\Rightarrow$$ 4k = 4 $$\Rightarrow$$ k = 1

$$\therefore$$ Coordinates of Q are (3, 0, 3)

$$\therefore$$ $$PQ = \sqrt {{{(3 - 2)}^2} + {{(0 + 1)}^2} + {{(3 - 2)}^2}} $$

$$ = \sqrt {1 + 1 + 1} = \sqrt 3 $$ units.

en.content: If $$b = \int\limits_0^1 {{{{e^t}} \over {t + 1}}dt} $$, then $$\int\limits_{a - 1}^a {{{{e^{ - t}}} \over {t - a - 1}}} $$ is
en.explanation:
We have, $$b = \int\limits_0^1 {{{{e^t}} \over {t + 1}}dt} $$

Let $$I = \int\limits_{a - 1}^a {{{{e^{ - t}}} \over {t - a - 1}}} dt$$

$$I = \int\limits_{a - 1}^a {{{{e^{ - (a + a - 1 - t)}}} \over {a + a - 1 - t - a - 1}}} dt$$

$$\because$$ $$\left[ {\int\limits_a^b {f(x)dx = \int\limits_a^b {f(a + b - x)dx} } } \right]$$

$$I = \int\limits_{a - 1}^a {{{{e^{t - 2a + 1}}} \over {a - 2 - t}}dt} $$

put $$t - (a - 1) = x \Rightarrow dt = dx$$

when t = a, x = 1 and t = a $$-$$ 1 $$\Rightarrow$$ x = 0

$$\therefore$$ $$I = \int\limits_0^1 {{{{e^{x + a - 1 - 2a + 1}}} \over {a - 2 - x - a + 1}}dx} $$

$$ \Rightarrow I = \int\limits_0^1 {{{{e^x}\,.\,{e^{ - a}}} \over { - (x + 1)}}dx} $$

$$ \Rightarrow I = - {e^{ - a}}\int\limits_0^1 {{{{e^x}} \over {x + 1}}dx} $$

$$ \Rightarrow I = - {e^{ - a}}(b)$$ $$\because$$ $$\left[ {\int\limits_0^1 {{{{e^t}} \over {t + 1}}dt = b} } \right]$$

$$ \Rightarrow I = - b{e^{ - a}}$$

$$\because$$ $$\left[ {\int\limits_a^b {f(x)dx = \int\limits_a^b {f(a + b - x)dx} } } \right]$$

$$I = \int\limits_{a - 1}^a {{{{e^{t - 2a + 1}}} \over {a - 2 - t}}dt} $$

$$ \Rightarrow I = - b{e^{ - a}}$$

en.explanation:
We have,

$$S = \{ (x,y):y = x + 1,0 < x < 2\} $$

For reflexive (x, x)$$\in$$S

x = x + 1 $$ \notin $$S

$$\therefore$$ S is not reflexive

$$\therefore$$ S is not equivalence relation

T = {(x, y) : x $$-$$ y is an integer}

For reflexive (x, x) $$\in$$T

x = x $$-$$ x = 0$$\in$$R

T is reflexive

For symmetric

(x, y) = x $$-$$ y is an integer

(y, x) = y $$-$$ x is also integer

$$\therefore$$ T is symmetric

For Transitive

(x, y) $$\in$$T, (y, z) $$\in$$T a $$\Rightarrow$$ (x, z) $$\in$$T

(x, y) = x $$-$$ y is an integer

(y, z) = y $$-$$ z is also integer

$$\therefore$$ (x $$-$$ y) + (y $$-$$ z) = x $$-$$ z is an integer

$$\therefore$$ (x, z) $$\in$$T

Hence, T is an equivalence relation.

en.content: The plane lx + my = 0 is rotated about its line of intersection with the plane z = 0 through an angle $$\alpha$$. The equation changes to
en.explanation:
Given plane,

P1 = lx + my = 0 and P2 = z = 0

Plane through common line of P1 and P2

$$\therefore$$ P3 = lx + my + nz = 0

angle between P1 and P3 = $$\alpha$$

$$\therefore$$ $$\cos \alpha = {{{l^2} + {m^2}} \over {\sqrt {{l^2} + {m^2} + {n^2}} \sqrt {{l^2} + {m^2}} }}$$

$$ \Rightarrow \cos \alpha = \sqrt {{{{l^2} + {m^2}} \over {{l^2} + {m^2} + {n^2}}}} $$

$$ \Rightarrow {\cos ^2}\alpha = {{{l^2} + {m^2}} \over {{l^2} + {m^2} + {n^2}}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {\sec ^2}\alpha = {{{l^2} + {m^2} + {n^2}} \over {{l^2} + {m^2}}} = 1 + {{{n^2}} \over {{l^2} + {m^2}}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow ({\sec ^2}\alpha - 1)({l^2} + {m^2}) = {n^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {n^2} = {\tan ^2}\alpha ({l^2} + {m^2}) = n = \pm \sqrt {({l^2} + {m^2})} \tan \alpha $$

$$\therefore$$ Equation becomes

$$lx + my \pm z\tan \alpha \sqrt {{l^2} + {m^2}} = 0$$

en.content: The points of intersection of two ellipses $${x^2} + 2{y^2} - 6x - 12y + 20 = 0$$ and $$2{x^2} + {y^2} - 10x - 6y + 15 = 0$$ lie on a circle. The centre of the circle is
en.explanation:
Given ellipse,

$${x^2} + 2{y^2} - 6x - 12y + 20 = 0$$ and

$$2{x^2} + {y^2} - 10x - 6y + 15 = 0$$

The point of intersection of the given ellipse is

$$({x^2} + 2{y^2} - 6x - 12y + 20) + \lambda (2{x^2} + {y^2} - 10x - 6y + 15) = 0$$

$$(1 + 2\lambda ){x^2} + (2 + \lambda ){y^2} - (6 + 10\lambda )x - (12 + 6\lambda ) + 20 + 5\lambda = 0$$

The points lie on circle

$$\therefore$$ Equation becomes circle

$$\therefore$$ $$1 + 2\lambda = 2 + \lambda \Rightarrow \lambda = 1$$

$$\therefore$$ Equation of circle is

$$3{x^2} + 3{y^2} - 16x - 18y + 35 = 0$$

$$\therefore$$ Centre of circle is $$\left( {{8 \over 3},3} \right)$$

bn.explanation:
উপবৃত্ত দেওয়া হয়েছে,

$${x^2} + 2{y^2} - 6x - 12y + 20 = 0$$ এবং

$$2{x^2} + {y^2} - 10x - 6y + 15 = 0$$

প্রদত্ত উপবৃত্তের ছেদ বিন্দু হল

$$({x^2} + 2{y^2} - 6x - 12y + 20) + \lambda (2{x^2} + {y^2} - 10x - 6y + 15) = 0$$

$$(1 + 2\lambda ){x^2} + (2 + \lambda ){y^2} - (6 + 10\lambda )x - (12 + 6\lambda ) + 20 + 5\lambda = 0$$

বিন্দু গুলি বৃত্তর উপর অবস্থিত

$$\therefore$$ সমীকরণ বৃত্তে পরিণত হয়

$$\therefore$$ $$1 + 2\lambda = 2 + \lambda \Rightarrow \lambda = 1$$

$$\therefore$$ বৃত্তের সমীকরণ হল

$$3{x^2} + 3{y^2} - 16x - 18y + 35 = 0$$

$$\therefore$$ বৃত্তের কেন্দ্র হল $$\left( {{8 \over 3},3} \right)$$

Centroid $$ = \left( {{a \over 3},{b \over 3},{c \over 3}} \right)$$

$$ \Rightarrow 5{r^2} + 5r - 12 = 3{r^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow 2{r^2} + 5r - 12 = 0$$

$$ \Rightarrow 2{r^2} + 8r - 3r - 12 = 0$$

$$ \Rightarrow I = \mathop {\lim }\limits_{n \to \infty } {1 \over n}\sum\limits_{r = 0}^{n - 1} {{1 \over {\sqrt {{{\left( {1 + {{4r} \over n}} \right)}^{3/2}}} }}} $$

f'(x) is decreasing function $$\forall$$ x > 0

$$ = {\pi \over 6} + {1 \over 4}\log 3$$

$$f\left( {\sqrt 3 } \right) = {\tan ^{ - 1}}\sqrt 3 - {1 \over 2}\log \sqrt 3 $$

$$ = {\pi \over 3} - {1 \over 4}\log 3$$

en.content: In Young's double slit experiment, light of wavelength $$\lambda$$ passes through the double slit and forms interference fringes on a screen 1.2 m away. If the difference between 3rd order maximum and 3rd order minimum is 0.18 cm and the slits are 0.02 cm apart, then $$\lambda$$ is
en.explanation:
Given, D = 1.2 m, d = 0.02 cm = 0.02 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$2 m

According to question,

$${{3D\lambda } \over d} - {{5D\lambda } \over {2d}} = 0.18 \times {10^{ - 2}}$$

$$\lambda \left[ {{{3 \times 1.2} \over {0.02 \times {{10}^{ - 2}}}} - {{5 \times 1.2} \over {2 \times 0.02 \times {{10}^{ - 2}}}}} \right] = 0.18 \times {10^{ - 2}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow \lambda \left[ {3 - {5 \over 2}} \right] \times 1.2 = 0.18 \times {10^{ - 2}} \times 0.02 \times {10^{ - 2}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow \lambda = {{0.18 \times {{10}^{ - 4}} \times 0.02 \times 2} \over {1.2}}$$ m

$$ \Rightarrow \lambda = 0.006 \times {10^{ - 4}}$$ m

$$ \Rightarrow \lambda = 600 \times {10^{ - 9}}$$ m

= 600 nm

ইয়ং-এর দ্বি-রেখাছিদ্র পরীক্ষায় $$\lambda $$ তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্যের আলাে, ছিদ্র থেকে 1.2 m দূরের পর্দায় ব্যতিচার ঝালর
তৈরি করে। যদি ছিদ্র দুটির মধ্যেকার দূরত্ব 0.02 cm হয় এবং তৃতীয় উজ্জ্বল পটি ও তৃতীয় অন্ধকার
পটির মধ্যেকার দূরত্ব 0.18 cm হয়ে তবে $$\lambda $$ এর মান হল
bn.explanation:
দেওয়া, D = 1.2 m, d = 0.02 cm = 0.02 $$\times$$ 10$$-$$2 m

প্রশ্ন অনুযায়ী,

$${{3D\lambda } \over d} - {{5D\lambda } \over {2d}} = 0.18 \times {10^{ - 2}}$$

$$\lambda \left[ {{{3 \times 1.2} \over {0.02 \times {{10}^{ - 2}}}} - {{5 \times 1.2} \over {2 \times 0.02 \times {{10}^{ - 2}}}}} \right] = 0.18 \times {10^{ - 2}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow \lambda \left[ {3 - {5 \over 2}} \right] \times 1.2 = 0.18 \times {10^{ - 2}} \times 0.02 \times {10^{ - 2}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow \lambda = {{0.18 \times {{10}^{ - 4}} \times 0.02 \times 2} \over {1.2}}$$ m

$$ \Rightarrow \lambda = 0.006 \times {10^{ - 4}}$$ m

$$ \Rightarrow \lambda = 600 \times {10^{ - 9}}$$ m

= 600 nm

en.content: A 12.5 eV electron beam is used to bombard gaseous hydrogen at ground state. The energy level upto which the hydrogen atoms would be excited is
en.explanation:
Let initially the electron in hydrogen atom be in ground state, i.e. n1 = 1 and after bombarding, it jumps to nth energy level i.e. n2 = n, then

12.5 eV $$ = \left[ {{{13.6} \over {{{(1)}^2}}} - {{13.6} \over {{n^2}}}} \right]$$ eV

$$ \Rightarrow 1 - {1 \over {{n^2}}} = {{12.5} \over {13.6}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow 1 - {{12.5} \over {13.6}} = {1 \over {{n^2}}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {1 \over {{n^2}}} = 0.080$$

$$ \Rightarrow n = 3.53 \approx 4$$

So, n2 = n = 4th excited state.

bn.content:
12.5 ev শক্তিবিশিষ্ট ইলেকট্রন স্রোত দ্বারা ভৌমস্তরে থাকা গ্যাসীয় হাইড্রোজেনের সংঘর্ষ ঘটানাে হল।
সংঘর্ষের ফলে হাইড্রোজেন পরমাণু যে শক্তিস্তরে উন্নীত হবে, তার মান
bn.explanation:
প্রাথমিকভাবে হাইড্রোজেন পরমাণুর ইলেকট্রন স্থল অবস্থায় থাকুক, i.e. n1 = 1 এবং বোমাবর্ষণের পরে, এটি nম শক্তি স্তরে চলে যায় অর্থাৎ n2 = n, তারপর

12.5 eV $$ = \left[ {{{13.6} \over {{{(1)}^2}}} - {{13.6} \over {{n^2}}}} \right]$$ eV

$$ \Rightarrow 1 - {1 \over {{n^2}}} = {{12.5} \over {13.6}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow 1 - {{12.5} \over {13.6}} = {1 \over {{n^2}}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {1 \over {{n^2}}} = 0.080$$

$$ \Rightarrow n = 3.53 \approx 4$$

সুতরাং, n2 = n = 4th উত্তেজিত অবস্থা.

en.content: Let r, v, E be the radius of orbit, speed of electron and total energy of electron respectively in H-atom. Which of the following quantities according to Bohr theory, is proportional to the quantum number n ?
en.explanation:
Radius (r) of nth orbit in H-atom $$ = {{{n^2}} \over Z} \times 0.529\mathop A\limits^o $$

Speed (v) of electron in nth orbit in H-atom $$ = 2.19 \times {10^6}\left( {{Z \over n}} \right)$$ m/s

Energy (E) of electron in nth orbit in H-atom $$ = {{ - 13.6} \over {{n^2}}}$$ eV

So, the quantity which is proportional to quantum number n is rv.

bn.content:
হাইড্রোজেন পরমাণুর ক্ষেত্রে r, v, E যথাক্রমে কক্ষপথের ব্যাসার্ধ, ইলেকট্রনের বেগ এবং ইলেকট্রনের
মােট শক্তি সূচিত করে। নীচের কোন রাশিটি বােরের তত্ত্বানুযায়ী, কোয়ান্টাম সংখ্যা n এর সঙ্গে
সমানুপাতিক ?
bn.explanation:
H-পরমাণুতে nth কক্ষপথের ব্যাসার্ধ (r) $$ = {{{n^2}} \over Z} \times 0.529\mathop A\limits^o $$

H-পরমাণুর nth কক্ষপথে ইলেকট্রনের গতি (v) $$ = 2.19 \times {10^6}\left( {{Z \over n}} \right)$$ m/s

H-পরমাণুর nth কক্ষপথে ইলেকট্রনের শক্তি (E) $$ = {{ - 13.6} \over {{n^2}}}$$ eV

সুতরাং, কোয়ান্টাম সংখ্যা n এর সমানুপাতিক পরিমাণ হল rv ।

en.content: From dimensional analysis, the Rydberg constant can be expressed in terms of electric charge (e), mass (m) and Planck constant (h) as [consider $${1 \over {4\pi {\varepsilon _0}}} \equiv 1$$ unit]
en.explanation:
According to question, from dimensional analysis,

R $$\propto$$ eambhc

$$\Rightarrow$$ R = keambhc

Using dimensional formula of R, e, m and h,

$$[{M^0}{L^{ - 1}}{T^0}] = {[{M^{1/2}}{L^{3/2}}{T^{ - 1}}]^a}{[M]^b}{[M{L^2}{T^{ - 1}}]^c}$$

{Since, $$F = {1 \over {4\pi {\varepsilon _0}}}\,.\,{{{e^2}} \over {{r^2}}} = {{{e^2}} \over {{r^2}}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {e^2} = F{r^2}$$

$$[e] = {[F{r^2}]^{1/2}} = {[ML{T^{ - 2}}\,.\,{L^2}]^{1/2}} = [{M^{1/2}}{L^{3/2}}{T^{ - 1}}]$$}

$$ \Rightarrow [{M^0}{L^{ - 1}}{T^0}] = [{M^{a/2}}{L^{3a/2}}{T^{ - a}}][{M^b}][{M^c}{L^{2c}}{T^{ - c}}]$$

$$ \Rightarrow [{M^0}{L^{ - 1}}{T^0}] = [{M^{{a \over 2} + b + c}}{L^{{{3a} \over 2} + 2c}}{T^{ - a - c}}]$$

$$\therefore$$ $${a \over 2} + b + c = 0$$ .... (i)

$${{3a} \over 2} + 2c = - 1$$ .... (ii)

$$-$$a $$-$$c = 0 .... (iii)

On solving Eqs. (i), (ii) and (iii), we get

a = 2, b = 1, c = $$-$$2

$$\therefore$$ R $$\propto$$ e2mh$$-$$2

$$ \Rightarrow R \propto {{{e^2}m} \over {{h^2}}}$$

bn.content:
মাত্রার নীতি অনুযায়ী, রিডবার্গ ধ্রুবককে ইলেকট্রনের আধান (e), ভর (m) ও প্লাঙ্কের ধ্রুবকের (h) সমন্বয়ে
প্রকাশ করলে তার রাশিমালা হবে ( $${1 \over {4\pi {\varepsilon _0}}} \equiv 1$$ একক ধরে নাও)
bn.explanation:
প্রশ্ন অনুসারে, মাত্রিক বিশ্লেষণ থেকে,

R $$\propto$$ eambhc

$$\Rightarrow$$ R = keambhc

R, e, m ও h এর মাত্রিক সূত্র ব্যবহার করে,

$$[{M^0}{L^{ - 1}}{T^0}] = {[{M^{1/2}}{L^{3/2}}{T^{ - 1}}]^a}{[M]^b}{[M{L^2}{T^{ - 1}}]^c}$$

{যেহেতু, $$F = {1 \over {4\pi {\varepsilon _0}}}\,.\,{{{e^2}} \over {{r^2}}} = {{{e^2}} \over {{r^2}}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {e^2} = F{r^2}$$

$$[e] = {[F{r^2}]^{1/2}} = {[ML{T^{ - 2}}\,.\,{L^2}]^{1/2}} = [{M^{1/2}}{L^{3/2}}{T^{ - 1}}]$$}

$$ \Rightarrow [{M^0}{L^{ - 1}}{T^0}] = [{M^{a/2}}{L^{3a/2}}{T^{ - a}}][{M^b}][{M^c}{L^{2c}}{T^{ - c}}]$$

$$ \Rightarrow [{M^0}{L^{ - 1}}{T^0}] = [{M^{{a \over 2} + b + c}}{L^{{{3a} \over 2} + 2c}}{T^{ - a - c}}]$$

$$\therefore$$ $${a \over 2} + b + c = 0$$ .... (i)

$${{3a} \over 2} + 2c = - 1$$ .... (ii)

$$-$$a $$-$$c = 0 .... (iii)

সমীকরণ (i), (ii) এবং (iii) সমাধান করার সময়, আমরা পাই

a = 2, b = 1, c = $$-$$2

$$\therefore$$ R $$\propto$$ e2mh$$-$$2

$$ \Rightarrow R \propto {{{e^2}m} \over {{h^2}}}$$

en.content: Three blocks are pushed with a force F across a frictionless table as shown in figure above. Let N1 be the contact force between the left two blocks and N2 be the contact force between the right two blocks. Then,
en.explanation:
Given,


Since, the table is frictionless, hence acceleration of the whole system is given as

$$a = {F \over {m + 2m + 3m}} = {F \over {6m}}$$

Free body diagram at 1st block (left most)


From Newton's equation of motion,

$$F - {N_1} = ma = m \times {F \over {6m}}$$ $$\because$$ $$\left( {a = {F \over {6m}}} \right)$$

$$ \Rightarrow {N_1} = {{5F} \over 6}$$

Free body diagram of 3rd block (right most)


From Newton's equation of motion,

$${N_2} = 3ma = 3m \times {F \over {6m}}$$ $$\because$$ $$\left( {a = {F \over {6m}}} \right)$$

$$ \Rightarrow {N_2} = {F \over 2}$$

Hence, F > N1 > N2.

bn.content: ঘর্ষণহীন একটি টেবিলের উপর রাখা চিত্রে দেখানাে তিনটি ব্লকের উপর F বল প্রয়ােগ করা হল। যদি বামদিকের ব্লকদুটির মধ্যে স্পর্শজনিত বল N1 ও ডানদিকের দুটি ব্লকের মধ্যে স্পর্শজনিত বল N2 হয় তবে
bn.explanation:
দেওয়া,


যেহেতু, টেবিলটি ঘর্ষণহীন, তাই পুরো সিস্টেমের ত্বরণ হিসাবে দেওয়া হয়েছে

$$F - {N_1} = ma = m \times {F \over {6m}}$$ $$\because$$ $$\left( {a = {F \over {6m}}} \right)$$

$$ \Rightarrow {N_1} = {{5F} \over 6}$$

তৃতীয় ব্লকের ফ্রি বডি ডায়াগ্রাম (সবচেয়ে ডানদিকে)

$${N_2} = 3ma = 3m \times {F \over {6m}}$$ $$\because$$ $$\left( {a = {F \over {6m}}} \right)$$

$$ \Rightarrow {N_2} = {F \over 2}$$

তাই, F > N1 > N2.

bn.content: একটি মসৃণ টেবিলের উপর m ভরের একটি ব্লক v বেগে অপর একটি m ভরের স্থির ব্লকের দিকে ধাবমান। স্থির ব্লকটির সাথে k স্প্রিং ধ্রুবক বিশিষ্ট একটি স্প্রিং আটকানাে আছে (চিত্রে প্রদর্শিত)। স্প্রিংটির সঙ্কোচনের সবােচর্চ পরিমাণ হবে
bn.explanation:

en.content: The acceleration versus distance graph for a particle moving with initial velocity 5 m/s is shown in the figure. The velocity of the particle at x = 35 m will be
en.explanation:
During first half of the motion (i.e. upto x = 20 m) acceleration in increasing linearly is given by

$$a = {5 \over {20}}x + 5 \Rightarrow a = {x \over 4} + 5$$

$$ \Rightarrow {{dv} \over {dt}} = {x \over 4} + 5$$ $$\because$$ $$\left( {a = {{dv} \over {dt}}} \right)$$

$$ \Rightarrow {{v\,.\,dt} \over {dx}} = {x \over 4} + 5$$ $$\because$$ $$\left( {{{dx} \over {dt}} = v \Rightarrow dt = {{dx} \over v}} \right)$$

$$ \Rightarrow \int\limits_5^v {v\,.\,dv = \int\limits_0^{20} {\left( {{x \over 4} + 5} \right)\,.\,dx} } $$

$$ \Rightarrow \left[ {{{{v^2}} \over 2}} \right]_5^v = \left[ {{{{x^2}} \over 8} + 5x} \right]_0^2$$

$$ \Rightarrow {{{v^2}} \over 5} - {{25} \over 2} = {{400} \over 8} + 100$$

$$ \Rightarrow {{{v^2}} \over 2} = 150 + {{25} \over 2} \Rightarrow {v^2} = 325$$

Now, in second half of motion, acceleration is constant, i.e. a = 10 m/s2

$$\Rightarrow$$ v2 $$-$$ u2 = 2as

$$\Rightarrow$$ v'2 $$-$$ v2 = 2as (take, v = v', u = v)

$$\Rightarrow$$ v'2 $$-$$ 325 = 2 $$\times$$ 10 $$\times$$ (35 $$-$$ 20) ($$\because$$ v2 = 325)

$$\Rightarrow$$ v' = $$\sqrt {625} $$ = 25 m/s

bn.content: চিত্রে একটি গতিশীল কণার ত্বরণ-সরন লেখচিত্র দেখানাে হয়েছে। কণাটির প্রাথমিক বেগ 5 m/s। যখন x = 35 m, তখন কণাটির গতিবেগ হবে
bn.explanation:
গতির প্রথমার্ধে (অর্থাৎ x = 20 মিটার পর্যন্ত) রৈখিকভাবে বৃদ্ধির ত্বরণ দেওয়া হয়

$$a = {5 \over {20}}x + 5 \Rightarrow a = {x \over 4} + 5$$

$$ \Rightarrow {{dv} \over {dt}} = {x \over 4} + 5$$ $$\because$$ $$\left( {a = {{dv} \over {dt}}} \right)$$

$$ \Rightarrow {{v\,.\,dt} \over {dx}} = {x \over 4} + 5$$ $$\because$$ $$\left( {{{dx} \over {dt}} = v \Rightarrow dt = {{dx} \over v}} \right)$$

$$ \Rightarrow \int\limits_5^v {v\,.\,dv = \int\limits_0^{20} {\left( {{x \over 4} + 5} \right)\,.\,dx} } $$

$$ \Rightarrow \left[ {{{{v^2}} \over 2}} \right]_5^v = \left[ {{{{x^2}} \over 8} + 5x} \right]_0^2$$

$$ \Rightarrow {{{v^2}} \over 5} - {{25} \over 2} = {{400} \over 8} + 100$$

$$ \Rightarrow {{{v^2}} \over 2} = 150 + {{25} \over 2} \Rightarrow {v^2} = 325$$

এখন, গতির দ্বিতীয়ার্ধে, ত্বরণ ধ্রুবক, যেমন a = 10 m/s2

$$\Rightarrow$$ v2 $$-$$ u2 = 2as

$$\Rightarrow$$ v'2 $$-$$ v2 = 2as (take, v = v', u = v)

$$\Rightarrow$$ v'2 $$-$$ 325 = 2 $$\times$$ 10 $$\times$$ (35 $$-$$ 20) ($$\because$$ v2 = 325)

$$\Rightarrow$$ v' = $$\sqrt {625} $$ = 25 m/s

en.content: A simple pendulum, consisting of a small ball of mass m attached to a massless string hanging vertically from the ceiling is oscillating with an amplitude such that T<sub>max</sub> = 2T<sub>min</sub>, where T<sub>max</sub> and T<sub>min</sub> are the maximum and minimum tension in the string, respectively. The value of maximum tension T<sub>max</sub> in the string is
en.explanation:
The given situation is shown below


$${T_{\min }} = mg\cos \theta $$ ..... (i)

$${T_{\max }} - mg = {{m{v^2}} \over l}$$ ..... (ii)

By law of conservation of energy,

$$mgh = {1 \over 2}m{v^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow mg(l - l\cos \theta ) = {1 \over 2}m{v^2}$$ [$$\because$$ $$h = l - l\cos \theta $$]

$$2mg(l - l\cos \theta ) = m{v^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow 2mgl(1 - \cos \theta ) = m{v^2}$$ ..... (iii)

From Eqs. (ii) and (iii), we get

$${T_{\max }} - mg = {{2mgl(1 - \cos \theta )} \over l}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {T_{\max }} - mg = 2mg(1 - \cos \theta )$$

$$ \Rightarrow 2{T_{\min }} - mg = 2mg(1 - \cos \theta )$$ [$$\because$$ $${T_{\max }} = 2{T_{\min }}$$]

$$ \Rightarrow 2mg\cos \theta - mg = 2mg(1 - \cos \theta )$$ [from Eq. (i)]

$$ \Rightarrow 2\cos \theta - 1 = 2(1 - \cos \theta )$$

$$ \Rightarrow 2\cos \theta - 1 = 2 - 2\cos \theta $$

$$ \Rightarrow 4\cos \theta = 3$$

$$ \Rightarrow \cos \theta = {3 \over 4}$$

$$\therefore$$ $${T_{\max }} = 2{T_{\min }} = 2mg\cos \theta = 2mg \times {3 \over 4} = {3 \over 2}mg$$

$$ \Rightarrow {T_{\max }} = {3 \over 2}mg$$

bn.content:
m ভরের একটি ক্ষুদ্র গােলকের সরল দোলক একটি ভরহীন সুতাের সাহায্যে সিলিং থেকে ঝােলানাে আছে।

দোলকটির দোলনকালে Tmax = 2Tmin হয়, যেখানে Tmax ও Tmin হল যথাক্রমে সুতােটির সর্বোচ্চ ও সর্বনিম্ন টান।

সেক্ষেত্রে সর্বোচ্চ টান Tmax -এর মান হবে
bn.explanation:
প্রদত্ত পরিস্থিতি নীচে দেখানো হয়েছে


$${T_{\min }} = mg\cos \theta $$ ..... (i)

$${T_{\max }} - mg = {{m{v^2}} \over l}$$ ..... (ii)

শক্তি সংরক্ষণ সূত্র দ্বারা,

$$mgh = {1 \over 2}m{v^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow mg(l - l\cos \theta ) = {1 \over 2}m{v^2}$$ [$$\because$$ $$h = l - l\cos \theta $$]

$$2mg(l - l\cos \theta ) = m{v^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow 2mgl(1 - \cos \theta ) = m{v^2}$$ ..... (iii)

সমীকরণ (ii) এবং (iii) থেকে, আমরা পাই

$${T_{\max }} - mg = {{2mgl(1 - \cos \theta )} \over l}$$

$$ \Rightarrow {T_{\max }} - mg = 2mg(1 - \cos \theta )$$

$$ \Rightarrow 2{T_{\min }} - mg = 2mg(1 - \cos \theta )$$ [$$\because$$ $${T_{\max }} = 2{T_{\min }}$$]

$$ \Rightarrow 2mg\cos \theta - mg = 2mg(1 - \cos \theta )$$ [সমীকরণ (i) থেকে]

$$ \Rightarrow 2\cos \theta - 1 = 2(1 - \cos \theta )$$

$$ \Rightarrow 2\cos \theta - 1 = 2 - 2\cos \theta $$

$$ \Rightarrow 4\cos \theta = 3$$

$$ \Rightarrow \cos \theta = {3 \over 4}$$

$$\therefore$$ $${T_{\max }} = 2{T_{\min }} = 2mg\cos \theta = 2mg \times {3 \over 4} = {3 \over 2}mg$$

$$ \Rightarrow {T_{\max }} = {3 \over 2}mg$$

en.content: In case of projectile motion, which one of the following figures represent variation of horizontal component of velocity (u<sub>x</sub>) with time t? (Assume that air resistance is negligible)

bn.content:
প্রাসের ক্ষেত্রে, গতিবেগের অনুভূমিক উপাংশ (u<sub>x</sub>) সময়ের (t) সাথে যেভাবে পরিবর্তিত হয় তা নিচের
